name.zh: 跨团队研发与安全交付

summary.zh: 覆盖需求基线、架构准入、并行研发、联合验证、灰度发布和运维复盘。
summary.en: Cover scope, architecture, parallel delivery, integrated validation, staged release and operations review.

instructions.zh: 覆盖需求基线、架构准入、并行研发、联合验证、灰度发布和运维复盘。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Cover scope, architecture, parallel delivery, integrated validation, staged release and operations review. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 产品与项目负责人收集关键使用场景，划定本次范围和可验证的验收标准。交付：需求与验收基线。
responsibility.en: Product and project leads define scenarios, scope and testable acceptance criteria. Deliver: scope and acceptance baseline.

responsibility.zh: 技术与安全人员识别接口、数据、外部依赖和信任边界，标明风险责任人。交付：依赖图与风险清单。
responsibility.en: Technical and security staff identify interfaces, data, dependencies and trust boundaries. Deliver: dependency map and risk register.

responsibility.zh: 核对目标、验收范围和风险清单并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review goals, acceptance scope and recorded risks and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 技术负责人拆解服务边界，确认接口、错误语义、迁移方案与方案取舍。交付：架构记录与接口契约。
responsibility.en: Technical leads define boundaries, interfaces, error handling and migration decisions. Deliver: architecture decisions and interface contracts.

responsibility.zh: 设计与产品人员确认关键路径、异常状态、交互原型与无障碍要求。交付：交互原型与设计说明。
responsibility.en: Design and product staff review journeys, exceptional states, prototypes and accessibility. Deliver: interaction prototype and design notes.

responsibility.zh: 测试与运维人员制定回归范围、可观测性、灰度验证和回退检查。交付：测试与发布检查方案。
responsibility.en: QA and operations define regression coverage, observability, rollout checks and rollback verification. Deliver: testing and release verification plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对接口契约、设计取舍与测试策略并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review interface contracts, design decisions and testing strategy and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 前端人员依据确认的交互与契约实现页面、状态和测试，标注偏差。交付：前端实现与测试结果。
responsibility.en: Frontend staff implement confirmed interactions and contracts, test states and record deviations. Deliver: frontend changes and test evidence.

responsibility.zh: 后端人员实现服务、事务和接口，验证权限、失败处理与数据一致性。交付：服务实现与验证记录。
responsibility.en: Backend staff implement services and transactions and check permissions, failures and consistency. Deliver: service changes and verification evidence.

responsibility.zh: 运维与安全人员检查依赖、构建产物、配置及环境，登记可部署版本。交付：环境与产物核对记录。
responsibility.en: Operations and security check dependencies, artifacts, configuration and the deployable version. Deliver: environment and artifact checks.

responsibility.zh: 核对实现、自检记录与集成准备并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review implementation, self-check evidence and integration readiness and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 研发人员核对跨服务契约和关键用户路径，记录接口及协作缺陷。交付：联调结果与问题清单。
responsibility.en: Developers verify cross-service contracts and user journeys and record integration defects. Deliver: integration evidence and issue list.

responsibility.zh: 测试与安全人员执行功能、回归和相关风险验证，区分阻断问题。交付：质量报告与风险处置。
responsibility.en: QA and security perform functional, regression and risk checks and identify blocking issues. Deliver: quality report and risk disposition.

responsibility.zh: 产品与验收负责人对照范围检查成果，确认限制、遗留事项和交付依据。交付：验收意见与遗留事项。
responsibility.en: Product and acceptance owners compare results with scope and identify limitations and remaining work. Deliver: acceptance findings and remaining items.

responsibility.zh: 核对联调、质量证据与用户验收并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review integration, quality evidence and user acceptance and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对版本、配置、迁移、监控和回退资料，明确发布与观察责任人。交付：发布包与运行手册。
responsibility.en: Verify versions, configuration, migrations, monitoring and rollback materials and assign release observers. Deliver: release package and runbook.

responsibility.zh: 成员在本地执行批准的发布方案，核对服务状态、核心指标与业务结果。交付：实际发布与观察记录。
responsibility.en: Members execute the approved rollout locally and verify health, key metrics and business results. Deliver: actual rollout and observation evidence.

responsibility.zh: 核对批准版本、灰度结果与恢复条件并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review approved artifacts, rollout evidence and recovery criteria and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 运维与支持人员确认值守、告警、故障路径和资料可用性，记录接收。交付：运行接收与支持清单。
responsibility.en: Operations and support confirm ownership, alerts, incident paths and usable handoff materials. Deliver: operations receipt and support checklist.

responsibility.zh: 团队核对交付收益、缺陷和协作问题，将后续改进整理为待审阅事项。交付：复盘与后续改进清单。
responsibility.en: The team reviews outcomes, defects and collaboration and records proposed future improvements. Deliver: retrospective and improvement backlog.

responsibility.zh: 核对运维接收、成果归档和改进计划并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review operations receipt, archived results and improvements and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 由运维与技术负责人按已确认预案回退或隔离，核对数据和依赖状态，提交故障处置与重新发布条件。
responsibility.en: Operators and technical leads execute an approved response, verify data and dependencies, and document recovery and release criteria.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

summary.zh: 区分影响评估、临时缓解、根因修复、跨团队回归与问题关闭。
summary.en: Separate impact assessment, mitigation, root-cause repair, cross-team regression and closure.

instructions.zh: 区分影响评估、临时缓解、根因修复、跨团队回归与问题关闭。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Separate impact assessment, mitigation, root-cause repair, cross-team regression and closure. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 收集输入、版本、日志与复现步骤，明确期望和实际表现。交付：可复现问题记录。
responsibility.en: Collect inputs, versions, logs and reproduction steps and compare expected and actual results. Deliver: reproducible issue record.

responsibility.zh: 产品、支持和技术人员核对受影响场景、用户与依赖，提出优先级。交付：影响范围与优先级建议。
responsibility.en: Product, support and technical staff assess affected scenarios, users and dependencies. Deliver: impact assessment and priority proposal.

responsibility.zh: 核对复现依据与影响边界并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review reproduction evidence and impact boundaries and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 结合运行证据和最近变更验证根因假设，记录尚未排除的解释。交付：根因分析与变更定位。
responsibility.en: Validate hypotheses against operational evidence and recent changes and record unresolved explanations. Deliver: root-cause analysis and change trace.

responsibility.zh: 评估隔离、降级与用户支持措施，执行经确认的缓解并观察结果。交付：缓解记录与观察结果。
responsibility.en: Assess containment, degradation and support options, then apply approved mitigation and observe results. Deliver: mitigation record and observation evidence.

responsibility.zh: 核对根因假设与临时措施并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review root-cause hypotheses and mitigation measures and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 确认代码、配置和受影响数据的处理方式，说明风险与回退条件。交付：修复方案与风险说明。
responsibility.en: Define code, configuration and data treatment and document risks and rollback conditions. Deliver: repair proposal and risk assessment.

responsibility.zh: 围绕复现、相邻功能和根因设计验证与长期改进，避免只验证表象。交付：回归与防复发清单。
responsibility.en: Design checks around reproduction, adjacent functions and root cause, plus prevention work. Deliver: regression and prevention plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对修复取舍与回归边界并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review repair tradeoffs and regression boundaries and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 责任成员完成修复和必要测试，登记变更内容与可回退版本。交付：修复变更与自检记录。
responsibility.en: Owners implement the repair and tests and record changes and recoverable versions. Deliver: repair changes and self-check evidence.

responsibility.zh: 测试与相关团队验证原问题、依赖接口和关键业务，核对附加影响。交付：回归报告与影响核对。
responsibility.en: QA and related teams verify the issue, interfaces and core business paths for side effects. Deliver: regression report and impact checks.

responsibility.zh: 核对实现证据与回归结果并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review repair evidence and regression results and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 按确认方案部署或应用修复，跟踪运行指标和用户场景的恢复结果。交付：实际恢复证据。
responsibility.en: Apply the approved repair and track operational metrics and recovered user scenarios. Deliver: actual recovery evidence.

responsibility.zh: 业务和支持人员核对受影响用户的反馈、补偿或沟通事项并确认状态。交付：业务恢复与支持记录。
responsibility.en: Business and support staff check affected-user feedback and required follow-up communication. Deliver: business recovery and support record.

responsibility.zh: 核对实际恢复结果与业务确认并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review actual recovery and business confirmation and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 归档复现、根因、变更与验证，明确遗留风险和关闭依据。交付：完整问题记录。
responsibility.en: Archive reproduction, cause, changes and checks with residual risks and closure evidence. Deliver: complete issue record.

responsibility.zh: 梳理监控、测试与工作流程的改进，形成需要确认的后续安排。交付：预防与复盘清单。
responsibility.en: Review monitoring, testing and process improvements and propose follow-up work. Deliver: prevention and retrospective checklist.

responsibility.zh: 核对关闭依据和预防措施并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review closure evidence and prevention measures and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 确认修复造成的附加影响，由责任人回退或隔离；保留原问题与新问题证据。
responsibility.en: Confirm additional impact, execute an approved rollback or containment, and preserve evidence of both issues.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

name.zh: 多环境发布与变更控制

summary.zh: 并行核对质量、配置与迁移，经过发布准入、灰度验证、恢复检查和运维接收。
summary.en: Review quality, configuration and migrations before rollout readiness, staged verification and operations receipt.

instructions.zh: 并行核对质量、配置与迁移，经过发布准入、灰度验证、恢复检查和运维接收。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Review quality, configuration and migrations before rollout readiness, staged verification and operations receipt. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 汇集待发布变更、成果验收与版本，核对关联任务和未解决问题。交付：发布范围与版本清单。
responsibility.en: Gather release changes, acceptance evidence and versions and check related work and unresolved issues. Deliver: release scope and version list.

responsibility.zh: 识别下游接口、数据、用户场景和发布窗口，提出通知与协调事项。交付：影响与协调清单。
responsibility.en: Identify downstream interfaces, data, user scenarios and release windows for coordination. Deliver: impact and coordination checklist.

responsibility.zh: 核对变更与受影响依赖并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review changes and affected dependencies and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 测试和安全人员核对阻断问题、风险处置和已确认的验收证据。交付：质量准入证据。
responsibility.en: QA and security review blocking issues, risk disposition and accepted evidence. Deliver: quality readiness evidence.

responsibility.zh: 运维人员比较环境配置、凭据引用、资源和外部服务可用性。交付：环境差异与资源检查。
responsibility.en: Operations compare environment settings, credential references, resources and external services. Deliver: environment differences and resource checks.

responsibility.zh: 核对质量结果与环境差异并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review quality results and environment differences and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 在隔离环境演练升级、数据处理及恢复步骤，记录时间和限制。交付：迁移与恢复演练记录。
responsibility.en: Rehearse upgrades, data treatment and recovery in isolation and record timing and limits. Deliver: migration and recovery rehearsal.

responsibility.zh: 明确变更顺序、验证点、决策责任人、回退条件和观察期限。交付：可审阅发布运行手册。
responsibility.en: Define change order, checks, decision owners, rollback criteria and observation periods. Deliver: reviewable release runbook.

responsibility.zh: 核对演练结果、迁移与回退并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review rehearsal, migration and rollback evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 整合版本、测试、演练与风险依据，列出发布所依赖的确认事项。交付：发布审阅包。
responsibility.en: Combine version, testing, rehearsal and risk evidence and list required confirmations. Deliver: release review package.

responsibility.zh: 确认发布、验证、业务支持和应急人员能在窗口内承担职责。交付：人员与窗口确认记录。
responsibility.en: Confirm release, verification, business support and response ownership during the window. Deliver: ownership and window confirmation.

responsibility.zh: 核对人审结论与可用发布包并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review human decisions and deployable artifacts and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 成员在本地按运行手册逐步发布，记录实际步骤与偏差。交付：实际发布记录。
responsibility.en: Members execute staged rollout locally using the runbook and record steps and deviations. Deliver: actual release record.

responsibility.zh: 核对服务、数据和关键用户路径，判断是否满足扩大发布或恢复的依据。交付：运行与业务核验结果。
responsibility.en: Verify services, data and critical journeys and assess evidence for wider rollout or recovery. Deliver: operational and business verification.

responsibility.zh: 核对灰度、业务与运行指标并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review staged rollout, business and operational results and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 交付运行资料、监控和故障路径，记录实际接收与后续观察。交付：运维接收记录。
responsibility.en: Hand over operational materials, monitoring and incident paths and record receipt and observation. Deliver: operations receipt.

responsibility.zh: 对照预期检查结果、偏差和恢复措施，形成改进建议。交付：发布复盘与改进。
responsibility.en: Compare outcomes, deviations and recovery measures with expectations and record improvements. Deliver: release retrospective and improvements.

responsibility.zh: 核对运维接收与变更归档并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review operations receipt and change archive and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

name.zh: 回退与数据一致性处置

responsibility.zh: 在确认的回退边界内恢复服务，核对数据、接口和配置状态，提交重新发布所需的证据。
responsibility.en: Restore within approved rollback boundaries, verify data, interfaces and configuration, and record evidence needed for another release.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

name.zh: AI 应用与模型全周期交付

summary.zh: 分开数据准入、模型实验、应用集成、评测发布与漂移监测，保留失败重训路径。
summary.en: Separate data readiness, model experiments, integration, evaluation, rollout and drift review with retraining paths.

instructions.zh: 分开数据准入、模型实验、应用集成、评测发布与漂移监测，保留失败重训路径。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Separate data readiness, model experiments, integration, evaluation, rollout and drift review with retraining paths. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 明确用户任务、可接受结果和成本时延目标，划分模型与人工处理边界。交付：应用需求与交付标准。
responsibility.en: Define user tasks, acceptable results, cost and latency goals, and human handling boundaries. Deliver: application requirements and delivery criteria.

responsibility.zh: 设计可重复的对比基线、评测样本和失败类别，记录覆盖不足。交付：评测协议与基线。
responsibility.en: Design reproducible baselines, evaluation samples and failure categories and note coverage gaps. Deliver: evaluation protocol and baseline.

responsibility.zh: 核对业务目标、基线与评测边界并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review business goals, baseline and evaluation boundaries and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对数据来源、使用范围和版本，确认适用的审阅和访问安排。交付：数据来源与使用记录。
responsibility.en: Check data origin, permitted use and versions and identify applicable review and access arrangements. Deliver: data lineage and use record.

responsibility.zh: 检查缺失、偏差、重复与标注一致性，确认训练评测划分。交付：数据质量与标注报告。
responsibility.en: Check missing data, bias, duplicates, labeling consistency and training-evaluation separation. Deliver: data quality and labeling report.

responsibility.zh: 规定特征口径、变换和输入输出契约，检查在线与离线一致性。交付：特征与数据契约。
responsibility.en: Define feature meanings, transformations and contracts and check offline-online consistency. Deliver: feature and data contracts.

responsibility.zh: 核对来源、质量与特征契约并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review lineage, quality and feature contracts and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 记录数据、参数、代码和环境，完成基线比较与实验复现。交付：实验记录与模型版本。
responsibility.en: Record data, parameters, code and environments and reproduce baseline comparisons. Deliver: experiment records and model version.

responsibility.zh: 实现接口、上下文与结果处理，设计超时、低可信输出和人工接管路径。交付：应用集成与失败处理说明。
responsibility.en: Implement interfaces and result handling with timeout, low-confidence and human handoff paths. Deliver: integration and failure-handling notes.

responsibility.zh: 准备输入输出、质量、成本和时延观察，避免记录不必要的敏感内容。交付：观测指标与运行方案。
responsibility.en: Prepare observation of inputs, quality, cost and latency without unnecessary sensitive content. Deliver: observability and operations plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对实验可复现性与集成结果并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review experiment reproducibility and integration results and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 对照基线评估主要场景、分组表现和失败类别，记录效果限制。交付：模型与应用质量报告。
responsibility.en: Compare key scenarios, cohort performance and failures against the baseline and record limits. Deliver: model and application quality report.

responsibility.zh: 验证相关攻击、越权输入、异常输出和人工接管处理，不将模型判断视为授权。交付：边界测试与风险记录。
responsibility.en: Check relevant attacks, unauthorized inputs, failures and human handoff without treating model judgments as authority. Deliver: boundary tests and risk record.

responsibility.zh: 核对效果、边界与运行表现并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review effectiveness, boundaries and runtime behavior and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对模型、数据、接口和配置版本，整合评测和恢复依据供人工确认。交付：可审阅运行包。
responsibility.en: Check model, data, interface and configuration versions and consolidate evaluation and recovery evidence. Deliver: reviewable runtime package.

responsibility.zh: 成员执行确认的发布，核对输出、质量、时延和成本，记录实际表现。交付：实际发布与观察结果。
responsibility.en: Members execute approved rollout and record outputs, quality, latency and cost. Deliver: actual rollout and observation results.

responsibility.zh: 核对批准版本、线上验证与降级条件并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review approved versions, live checks and fallback criteria and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 比较当前输入和结果与基线，收集异常案例及用户反馈。交付：漂移与反馈报告。
responsibility.en: Compare current inputs and results with the baseline and collect exceptions and user feedback. Deliver: drift and feedback report.

responsibility.zh: 根据证据提出数据修订、重训或版本恢复建议，由项目人员决定后续工作。交付：重训与恢复建议。
responsibility.en: Use evidence to propose data updates, retraining or version recovery for human planning. Deliver: retraining and recovery proposal.

responsibility.zh: 核对漂移、反馈与重训依据并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review drift, feedback and retraining evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常输出和数据来源，由成员按预案隔离、恢复或降级，保留模型与数据版本证据。
responsibility.en: Investigate outputs and data lineage, apply approved containment or fallback, and preserve model and data versions.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

summary.zh: 从口径、来源与质量检查，经过采集转换、分析复核和数据产品交接。
summary.en: Move from definitions, sources and quality through collection, transformation, analytical review and handoff.

instructions.zh: 从口径、来源与质量检查，经过采集转换、分析复核和数据产品交接。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Move from definitions, sources and quality through collection, transformation, analytical review and handoff. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 访谈业务使用者，明确需要回答的问题、决策用途和交付形式。交付：问题与使用场景清单。
responsibility.en: Interview users to define questions, decision use and delivery formats. Deliver: question and use-case list.

responsibility.zh: 定义指标、维度、时间窗口和解释范围，标注存在争议的口径。交付：指标与语义字典。
responsibility.en: Define metrics, dimensions, time windows and interpretation boundaries and flag disputed definitions. Deliver: metric and semantic dictionary.

responsibility.zh: 核对业务问题、指标与交付口径并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review business questions, metrics and delivery definitions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 登记数据系统、负责人、访问方式和刷新依赖，核对使用范围。交付：来源和依赖登记。
responsibility.en: Register source systems, ownership, access, refresh dependencies and permitted use. Deliver: source and dependency register.

responsibility.zh: 检验缺失、异常、重复、时序及标识关联，明确修复和接受的范围。交付：数据质量盘点。
responsibility.en: Profile missing values, outliers, duplicates, timing and identifiers and define treatment boundaries. Deliver: data quality assessment.

responsibility.zh: 核对来源可信性与质量范围并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review source reliability and quality boundaries and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 成员建设可追溯的采集与转换，记录来源版本、重放和失败处理方式。交付：采集转换与血缘记录。
responsibility.en: Build traceable collection and transformation with source versions, replay and failure handling. Deliver: pipeline and lineage evidence.

responsibility.zh: 按确认口径建设模型，核对主键、聚合、关联和增量计算结果。交付：数据模型与校验结果。
responsibility.en: Build models against approved definitions and validate identifiers, aggregation, joins and incremental results. Deliver: data models and validation results.

responsibility.zh: 核对管道、语义模型和测试依据并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review pipelines, semantic models and testing evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 基于固定数据版本完成分析，保留方法、代码、参数和中间结果。交付：分析结果与可复现材料。
responsibility.en: Analyze fixed data versions and preserve methods, code, parameters and intermediate results. Deliver: analysis results and reproducible materials.

responsibility.zh: 独立核对关键结果、样本和口径，区分事实、估计与推断。交付：复核记录与限制说明。
responsibility.en: Independently verify important results and definitions and distinguish facts, estimates and inferences. Deliver: verification record and limitations.

responsibility.zh: 核对分析依据与解释限制并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review analytical evidence and interpretation limits and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 制作面向使用者的报表或数据接口，说明含义、更新频率和适用范围。交付：数据产品与使用说明。
responsibility.en: Create user-facing reports or data interfaces with definitions, refresh frequency and applicability. Deliver: data product and usage notes.

responsibility.zh: 核对访问范围、刷新失败处理、告警与负责人安排。交付：运行与访问验证记录。
responsibility.en: Check access boundaries, refresh failure handling, alerts and ownership. Deliver: operations and access validation.

responsibility.zh: 核对业务可用性与运行条件并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review business usability and operational conditions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 由业务和维护人员核对成果与资料，记录接收和使用问题。交付：交付接收与培训记录。
responsibility.en: Business and maintenance staff review deliverables and record receipt and usage issues. Deliver: delivery receipt and training record.

responsibility.zh: 持续登记质量与口径变化，评估影响后提出版本或流程调整。交付：维护与变更记录。
responsibility.en: Track quality and definition changes and propose version updates after impact review. Deliver: maintenance and change record.

responsibility.zh: 核对接收、问题跟踪与维护责任并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review receipt, issue tracking and maintenance ownership and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 定位错误口径和受影响下游，隔离结果，重建经确认的数据版本并记录影响。
responsibility.en: Identify incorrect definitions and downstream impact, isolate results and rebuild approved data versions.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: NIH 研究严谨性与可重复性

name.zh: 系统迁移与业务连续性

summary.zh: 覆盖资产依赖、迁移设计、并行准备、演练、割接准入、验证和运维接收。
summary.en: Cover asset dependencies, migration design, parallel preparation, rehearsals, cutover checks and operational receipt.

instructions.zh: 覆盖资产依赖、迁移设计、并行准备、演练、割接准入、验证和运维接收。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Cover asset dependencies, migration design, parallel preparation, rehearsals, cutover checks and operational receipt. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 登记系统、版本、数据、负责人和运行方式，标明需要保留的历史与服务。交付：资产与责任清单。
responsibility.en: Inventory systems, versions, data, ownership and operations and identify history and services to preserve. Deliver: asset and ownership inventory.

responsibility.zh: 评估接口、流量、窗口和恢复目标，确认系统间的割接先后与限制。交付：依赖图与连续性要求。
responsibility.en: Assess interfaces, traffic, windows and recovery goals and identify cutover ordering constraints. Deliver: dependency map and continuity requirements.

responsibility.zh: 核对资产、依赖与业务约束并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review assets, dependencies and business constraints and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 选择分批、同步或替代方案，说明目标环境、迁移范围和限制。交付：迁移策略与目标设计。
responsibility.en: Select staged, synchronized or replacement approaches and define target scope and limits. Deliver: migration strategy and target design.

responsibility.zh: 定义数据迁移、写入切换、回退边界和无法直接回退时的恢复办法。交付：数据与恢复设计。
responsibility.en: Define data migration, write cutover, rollback boundaries and recovery when direct rollback is unsuitable. Deliver: data and recovery design.

responsibility.zh: 核对目标架构与迁移取舍并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review target architecture and migration decisions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 成员配置网络、资源、访问和监控，核对目标服务可用性。交付：目标环境与访问检查。
responsibility.en: Members prepare networking, resources, access and monitoring and verify target services. Deliver: target environment and access checks.

responsibility.zh: 验证迁移工具、映射、同步和一致性检查，保留可核对的源版本。交付：迁移工具与一致性证据。
responsibility.en: Validate tools, mapping, synchronization and consistency checks against identifiable source versions. Deliver: migration tooling and consistency evidence.

responsibility.zh: 明确窗口、步骤、验证、观察和恢复的负责人及通知方式。交付：割接运行手册。
responsibility.en: Define owners and communication for the window, steps, checks, observation and recovery. Deliver: cutover runbook.

responsibility.zh: 核对环境、数据与协作准备并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review environment, data and coordination readiness and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 在隔离范围演练迁移和验证，记录耗时、偏差与依赖问题。交付：迁移演练记录。
responsibility.en: Rehearse migration and verification in isolation and record timing, deviations and dependencies. Deliver: migration rehearsal record.

responsibility.zh: 验证可恢复条件、工具和数据状态，确认超窗或故障时的人工决策依据。交付：恢复演练与准入依据。
responsibility.en: Verify recovery conditions, tools and data state and document decisions for outages or window overruns. Deliver: recovery rehearsal and readiness evidence.

responsibility.zh: 核对演练时间、验证与恢复能力并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review rehearsal timing, checks and recovery capability and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 按确认方案切换服务或数据，逐步登记实际时间、变更和数据边界。交付：实际割接记录。
responsibility.en: Execute approved service or data cutover and record timing, changes and data boundaries. Deliver: actual cutover record.

responsibility.zh: 共同核对功能、性能、接口、数据和业务场景，判断恢复或继续的依据。交付：联合割接验证报告。
responsibility.en: Jointly check functions, performance, interfaces, data and business scenarios to support recovery or continuation. Deliver: joint cutover verification report.

responsibility.zh: 核对实际割接与业务核验并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review actual cutover and business verification and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 确认值守、监控、资料、备份和恢复安排，记录接收与观察结果。交付：运维接收资料。
responsibility.en: Confirm monitoring, materials, backups, recovery and ownership and record receipt and observation. Deliver: operations receipt materials.

responsibility.zh: 核对可退役范围、保留数据和剩余问题，取得确认后安排后续处置。交付：迁移复盘与后续计划。
responsibility.en: Review retirement scope, retained data and remaining issues before proposing follow-up treatment. Deliver: migration retrospective and follow-up plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对运维接收与遗留系统处理并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review operations receipt and legacy-system treatment and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 由成员按已确认的回退或向前恢复方案处置，核对数据写入边界、依赖服务和业务恢复证据。
responsibility.en: Members apply approved rollback or recovery, verify data-write boundaries, dependent services and business recovery evidence.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

summary.zh: 把用户研究、问题定义、并行设计、可用性验证和设计交付分开评审。
summary.en: Review user research, problem definition, parallel design, usability validation and design handoff separately.

instructions.zh: 把用户研究、问题定义、并行设计、可用性验证和设计交付分开评审。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Review user research, problem definition, parallel design, usability validation and design handoff separately. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 确定研究问题、目标用户、样本范围和访谈安排，核对研究材料使用方式。交付：研究计划与样本说明。
responsibility.en: Define research questions, user groups, sample boundaries and interview arrangements. Deliver: research plan and sample rationale.

responsibility.zh: 收集使用过程、行为与痛点，区分原始记录和团队解释。交付：原始证据与观察记录。
responsibility.en: Collect usage, behavior and pain points and distinguish observations from interpretation. Deliver: source evidence and observation notes.

responsibility.zh: 核对研究问题与可追溯用户证据并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review research questions and traceable user evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 整理重复问题、矛盾和机会，建立可追溯到材料的判断依据。交付：洞察与机会地图。
responsibility.en: Synthesize repeated problems, contradictions and opportunities with traceable evidence. Deliver: insight and opportunity map.

responsibility.zh: 把问题转成目标、适用范围、优先级和可验证的体验指标。交付：问题陈述与成功指标。
responsibility.en: Translate problems into goals, scope, priorities and testable experience measures. Deliver: problem statement and success measures.

responsibility.zh: 核对用户洞察与成功指标并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review user insights and success measures and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 设计用户路径、信息结构及异常状态，准备可用于验证的原型。交付：交互结构与原型。
responsibility.en: Design journeys, information structure and exceptional states in a testable prototype. Deliver: interaction structure and prototype.

responsibility.zh: 建立视觉层次、组件状态和统一样式，核对既有设计系统。交付：视觉规范与组件说明。
responsibility.en: Define hierarchy, component states and consistent styling against the existing design system. Deliver: visual standards and component notes.

responsibility.zh: 核对方案取舍与关键体验覆盖并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review design tradeoffs and coverage of key experiences and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 整合方案，设计用户测试任务、观察点和记录方式。交付：测试原型与任务脚本。
responsibility.en: Integrate designs and prepare user-test tasks, observation points and recording methods. Deliver: test prototype and task script.

responsibility.zh: 与研发核对实现成本、数据依赖、交互边界和无障碍可实现性。交付：实施约束与调整建议。
responsibility.en: Review implementation cost, data dependencies, interaction boundaries and accessibility feasibility with engineering. Deliver: implementation constraints and adjustments.

name.zh: 原型与实施可行性评审

responsibility.zh: 核对可验证原型和实施约束并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review testable prototypes and implementation constraints and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 观察关键任务完成、错误和理解偏差，收集与指标对应的证据。交付：可用性测试记录。
responsibility.en: Observe task completion, errors and comprehension and collect evidence against the measures. Deliver: usability testing record.

responsibility.zh: 核对假设是否成立，标注需要修改的路径、文案或组件。交付：验证结论与修订清单。
responsibility.en: Assess assumptions and identify journeys, copy or components needing revision. Deliver: validation findings and revision list.

responsibility.zh: 核对任务表现与假设验证并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review task performance and validated assumptions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 整理组件、交互、资源和验收依据，明确设计接收责任。交付：设计交付包。
responsibility.en: Package components, interactions, assets and acceptance evidence with handoff ownership. Deliver: design handoff package.

responsibility.zh: 跟进实现偏差和用户反馈，形成后续验证与体验改进事项。交付：体验复盘与改进事项。
responsibility.en: Track implementation deviations and user feedback and propose further experience checks. Deliver: experience retrospective and improvements.

responsibility.zh: 核对交付完整性与后续验证安排并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review handoff completeness and further validation and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 记录未达标的任务、用户反馈和根因，重新检查问题定义及设计假设，提出改版范围。
responsibility.en: Record failed tasks, feedback and causes, revisit problem definitions and assumptions, and propose redesign scope.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

name.zh: 品牌系统与多媒介制作

summary.zh: 覆盖品牌定位、创意取舍、并行资产制作、品牌审核、打样和最终交付。
summary.en: Cover positioning, creative choices, parallel asset production, brand review, proofing and final delivery.

instructions.zh: 覆盖品牌定位、创意取舍、并行资产制作、品牌审核、打样和最终交付。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Cover positioning, creative choices, parallel asset production, brand review, proofing and final delivery. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 整理品牌现状、受众反馈和竞争表达，确认核心沟通问题。交付：品牌研究与洞察。
responsibility.en: Review the brand, audience feedback and competing expressions to define communication problems. Deliver: brand research and insights.

responsibility.zh: 确认用途、渠道、预算、交付规格和适用素材使用要求。交付：创意任务书。
responsibility.en: Confirm purpose, channels, budget, delivery specifications and asset-use requirements. Deliver: creative brief.

responsibility.zh: 核对受众、定位与使用范围并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review audience, positioning and usage scope and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 提出多种概念，说明各自与定位、受众和渠道的关系。交付：创意概念与取舍依据。
responsibility.en: Develop alternatives and explain alignment with positioning, audience and channels. Deliver: creative concepts and tradeoffs.

responsibility.zh: 定义标识、色彩、字体、构图和基础应用的统一关系。交付：视觉系统草案。
responsibility.en: Define consistent logo, color, typography, composition and basic applications. Deliver: visual system draft.

responsibility.zh: 核对创意方向与系统一致性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review creative direction and system consistency and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 制作主视觉、图形与可编辑母版，登记素材与版本。交付：可编辑视觉母版。
responsibility.en: Produce key visuals, graphics and editable masters with source and version records. Deliver: editable visual masters.

responsibility.zh: 完成文案与不同渠道版式，核对信息层次和内容一致性。交付：渠道文案与适配稿。
responsibility.en: Develop copy and channel layouts and check hierarchy and consistency. Deliver: channel copy and adaptations.

responsibility.zh: 核对母版、文案与媒介适配并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review master assets, copy and media adaptation and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 检查视觉、语气、组件使用和渠道表现是否符合已确认方向。交付：品牌核对与修改清单。
responsibility.en: Check visuals, voice, component usage and channel presentation against approved direction. Deliver: brand checks and revision list.

responsibility.zh: 核对信息准确性、素材来源和适用使用范围，登记未解决事项。交付：素材与内容核对记录。
responsibility.en: Verify content accuracy, asset sources and permitted usage and record unresolved issues. Deliver: asset and content verification.

responsibility.zh: 核对品牌一致性与素材可用性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review brand consistency and usable assets and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 在实际媒介或样品上核对色彩、尺寸、清晰度与显示效果。交付：打样与媒介检查。
responsibility.en: Verify color, size, clarity and rendering on actual media or proofs. Deliver: proofing and media checks.

responsibility.zh: 检查导出、字体、分辨率、版本和供应商交付规格。交付：制作文件与规格确认。
responsibility.en: Review exports, fonts, resolution, versions and supplier delivery requirements. Deliver: production files and confirmed specifications.

responsibility.zh: 核对实物或媒介效果与规格并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review physical or media results and specifications and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 归档母版、导出稿和使用规范，明确修改与分发的责任人。交付：品牌交付与使用包。
responsibility.en: Archive masters, exports and usage guidance with revision and distribution ownership. Deliver: brand delivery and usage package.

responsibility.zh: 确认接收并观察实际应用，记录偏差和后续素材需求。交付：接收与应用反馈。
responsibility.en: Confirm receipt and observe applications to record deviations and future asset needs. Deliver: receipt and application feedback.

responsibility.zh: 核对接收、使用规范与资产版本并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review receipt, usage guidance and asset versions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 定位色彩、尺寸、字体或授权问题，确认受影响素材，修正母版并重新核验。
responsibility.en: Identify color, size, typography or usage issues, correct master assets and repeat verification.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

summary.zh: 区分选题、资料与初稿、编辑与事实复核、排版与校对、发行及更正归档。
summary.en: Separate commissioning, evidence and drafting, editing, fact review, layout, proofing, release and correction records.

instructions.zh: 区分选题、资料与初稿、编辑与事实复核、排版与校对、发行及更正归档。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Separate commissioning, evidence and drafting, editing, fact review, layout, proofing, release and correction records. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 明确读者、主题、篇幅和内容价值，检查与既有内容的关系。交付：选题说明与内容目标。
responsibility.en: Define readers, topic, length and value and review related existing content. Deliver: commissioning brief and content goals.

responsibility.zh: 约定稿件结构、交稿、审阅、素材和出版格式要求。交付：制作计划与稿件规范。
responsibility.en: Agree manuscript structure, handoff, reviews, assets and publication formats. Deliver: production plan and manuscript requirements.

responsibility.zh: 核对读者目标、选题与制作条件并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review reader goals, topic and production conditions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对引用与素材来源，记录缺口、适用使用范围和事实依据。交付：引用与素材登记。
responsibility.en: Verify sources and assets and record gaps, usage boundaries and evidence. Deliver: source and asset register.

responsibility.zh: 依据内容目标建立结构与论述，标出待核实内容和缺失材料。交付：可审阅初稿。
responsibility.en: Build structure and argument against the content goals and flag uncertain statements or missing material. Deliver: reviewable first draft.

responsibility.zh: 核对可追溯资料与完整初稿并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review traceable sources and a complete draft and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 编辑核对论述、可读性与风格，记录修改依据与作者确认事项。交付：编辑稿与修改记录。
responsibility.en: Editors review argument, readability and style and record revision reasons and author queries. Deliver: edited draft and revision record.

responsibility.zh: 独立复核关键事实、引用、表格与图注，标注需作者说明的问题。交付：事实复核与问题清单。
responsibility.en: Independently verify key facts, citations, tables and captions and flag author queries. Deliver: fact review and query list.

responsibility.zh: 核对结构、表达与事实准确性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review structure, expression and factual accuracy and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 按确认样式排版，核对标题、注释、目录、图表和跨页关系。交付：版式样稿。
responsibility.en: Typeset against approved styles and check headings, notes, contents, figures and pagination. Deliver: layout proof.

responsibility.zh: 制作封面、简介与发行素材，核对内容定位和稿件版本。交付：封面与发布素材。
responsibility.en: Prepare cover, description and publication assets and check alignment with content and version. Deliver: cover and publication assets.

responsibility.zh: 核对文稿、视觉与格式一致性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review text, visuals and formatting consistency and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 作者和校对人员检查排版后的文字、图表与更正，区分必要改动和范围扩张。交付：校对意见与作者确认。
responsibility.en: Authors and proofreaders inspect text, figures and corrections and distinguish necessary edits from scope expansion. Deliver: proofreading findings and author confirmation.

responsibility.zh: 核对所有更正是否落实，验证出版文件、链接和发行版本。交付：最终成品与核验记录。
responsibility.en: Confirm corrections are applied and verify publication files, links and release versions. Deliver: final files and verification evidence.

responsibility.zh: 核对最终样稿、修订闭合与版本并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review final proofs, closed revisions and versions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 成员完成确认的发布，归档最终稿、制作文件和实际发布依据。交付：发布与成果归档。
responsibility.en: Members complete approved publication and archive final manuscripts, production files and release evidence. Deliver: publication and result archive.

responsibility.zh: 收集读者和使用反馈，登记更正、版本变化及后续修订建议。交付：反馈与更正记录。
responsibility.en: Collect reader and usage feedback and record corrections, version changes and future revisions. Deliver: feedback and correction record.

responsibility.zh: 核对实际发布、归档与后续更正并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review actual release, archives and subsequent corrections and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 确认差错及影响版本，冻结受影响稿件，按项目安排修订、更正与再次校对。
responsibility.en: Confirm errors and affected versions, hold the material and perform approved correction and re-proofing.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

summary.zh: 从主题与素材到文案、视觉并行生产，经过联合审核、渠道验证与发布复盘。
summary.en: Move from themes and sources through parallel copy and visuals, joint review, channel checks and publication retrospective.

instructions.zh: 从主题与素材到文案、视觉并行生产，经过联合审核、渠道验证与发布复盘。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Move from themes and sources through parallel copy and visuals, joint review, channel checks and publication retrospective. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 明确受众、关键信息和期望行动，记录需要验证的表达假设。交付：主题与受众任务书。
responsibility.en: Define audiences, key messages and desired actions and record communication assumptions. Deliver: theme and audience brief.

responsibility.zh: 确认渠道、格式、尺寸、发布时间和渠道之间的内容关系。交付：渠道与规格清单。
responsibility.en: Confirm channels, formats, sizes, timing and relationships between content versions. Deliver: channel and specification list.

responsibility.zh: 核对传播目标与内容约束并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review communication goals and content constraints and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 整理事实、引用、图片与素材使用依据，列出缺口和需确认内容。交付：内容与素材登记。
responsibility.en: Collect facts, citations, images and usage evidence and flag gaps and queries. Deliver: content and asset register.

responsibility.zh: 设计内容结构、系列关系和信息层次，避免渠道间信息矛盾。交付：内容结构与系列计划。
responsibility.en: Design structure, series relationships and hierarchy and prevent conflicting channel messages. Deliver: content structure and series plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对事实依据与叙事结构并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review factual evidence and narrative structure and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 创作文案和渠道变体，标记共同事实、渠道差异和需要配图的位置。交付：文案与渠道变体。
responsibility.en: Create copy and channel variants and mark shared facts, channel differences and visual requirements. Deliver: copy and channel variants.

responsibility.zh: 按叙事需要制作图形、图片与模板，登记与文案版本的关联。交付：视觉稿与版本对应。
responsibility.en: Create visuals and templates for the narrative and track their relationship to copy versions. Deliver: visual drafts and version mapping.

name.en: Parallel text and visual production review

responsibility.zh: 核对文案、视觉与版本关联并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review copy, visuals and linked versions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对核心信息、数据、引用和文案语气，确认需更正的内容。交付：编辑审阅与更正清单。
responsibility.en: Review key messages, data, citations and tone and identify required corrections. Deliver: editorial review and correction list.

responsibility.zh: 核对视觉规范、图文关系和渠道风格，记录审阅反馈与取舍。交付：联合图文审阅记录。
responsibility.en: Review visual standards, text-visual relationships and channel style and record feedback and choices. Deliver: joint text and visual review.

responsibility.zh: 核对图文一致性与表达准确性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review text-visual consistency and accuracy and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 在目标渠道预览文字、图像、链接和交互，核对版本与适配。交付：渠道预览与核验。
responsibility.en: Preview text, images, links and interactions on target channels and check versions and adaptation. Deliver: channel previews and verification.

responsibility.zh: 确认发布节奏和责任人，由成员完成发布并登记实际渠道和版本。交付：实际发布清单。
responsibility.en: Confirm publication timing and ownership, then publish and record actual channels and versions. Deliver: actual publication list.

responsibility.zh: 核对渠道实测、最终稿与发布记录并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review channel checks, final content and release evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 按目标收集访问、互动与受众反馈，说明指标来源和解释范围。交付：内容效果与反馈报告。
responsibility.en: Collect reach, engagement and audience feedback against goals and explain measurement limits. Deliver: content results and feedback report.

responsibility.zh: 归档可复用素材、稿件和更正，整理后续选题与修订建议。交付：内容资产与维护记录。
responsibility.en: Archive reusable assets, content and corrections and propose future topics and revisions. Deliver: content assets and maintenance record.

responsibility.zh: 核对反馈、效果与版本维护并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review feedback, results and version maintenance and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

name.zh: 跨渠道差错与撤回修订

responsibility.zh: 核对受影响内容与渠道，由成员按确认方案更正或撤回，保持稿件和发布版本可追溯。
responsibility.en: Identify affected content and channels and apply approved correction or withdrawal with traceable versions.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: 澳大利亚政府营销计划指南

summary.zh: 覆盖剧本与预算、前期准备、现场素材、剪辑、并行后期、成片审核和交付。
summary.en: Cover script and budget, preparation, captured media, editing, parallel post-production, final review and delivery.

instructions.zh: 覆盖剧本与预算、前期准备、现场素材、剪辑、并行后期、成片审核和交付。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Cover script and budget, preparation, captured media, editing, parallel post-production, final review and delivery. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 明确主题、叙事、脚本和镜头需求，检查与受众及交付目标的关系。交付：脚本与镜头需求。
responsibility.en: Define theme, narrative, script and shot requirements against audience and delivery goals. Deliver: script and shot requirements.

responsibility.zh: 核对预算、人员、地点、设备、排期和成片规格。交付：制作计划与预算。
responsibility.en: Review budget, people, locations, equipment, schedule and final formats. Deliver: production plan and budget.

responsibility.zh: 核对创意、预算与交付规格并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review creative direction, budget and delivery specifications and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 把脚本拆为场景、镜头、现场顺序和必要素材，登记替代方案。交付：分镜与拍摄计划。
responsibility.en: Break the script into scenes, shots, filming order and required materials with alternatives. Deliver: storyboard and shooting plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对人员、场地、设备测试、素材使用安排和现场应急职责。交付：拍摄就绪检查。
responsibility.en: Confirm people, locations, equipment tests, usage arrangements and site response ownership. Deliver: shooting readiness checks.

responsibility.zh: 核对分镜、现场与录制条件并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review storyboards, site and recording readiness and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 完成镜头与音频采集，记录场次、版本、现场偏差和可用性。交付：现场素材与场记。
responsibility.en: Capture shots and audio and record scenes, versions, deviations and usability. Deliver: captured media and production notes.

responsibility.zh: 核对素材命名、数量、完整性和备份，登记无法补拍或缺失的问题。交付：素材清单与备份证据。
responsibility.en: Check naming, quantity, integrity and backups and record missing or unrecoverable media. Deliver: media inventory and backup evidence.

name.zh: 现场制作与素材管理评审

responsibility.zh: 核对现场成果、素材完整性与备份并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review captured results, media completeness and backups and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 按主题与脚本整理粗剪，核对节奏、信息和缺失镜头。交付：粗剪与修改记录。
responsibility.en: Assemble a rough cut and check pace, information and missing shots against the script. Deliver: rough cut and revision record.

responsibility.zh: 落实审阅修改，记录进入后期的画面版本和未解决事项。交付：锁定画面与后期交接。
responsibility.en: Apply review changes and record the picture version and unresolved items for post-production. Deliver: picture lock and post-production handoff.

responsibility.zh: 核对剪辑结构与画面锁定依据并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review edit structure and picture-lock evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 完成调色、图形和视觉修整，核对与锁定画面的版本关系。交付：视觉后期成果。
responsibility.en: Complete color, graphics and visual finishing against the locked picture version. Deliver: visual finishing result.

responsibility.zh: 完成混音、字幕和片尾信息，核对时序、语言与素材使用记录。交付：声音与文字后期成果。
responsibility.en: Finish mixing, captions and credits and verify timing, language and usage records. Deliver: audio and text finishing result.

responsibility.zh: 核对画面、声音与文字一致性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review picture, audio and text consistency and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 对照制作目标审阅成片，集中记录意见、确认人与修改范围。交付：成片审阅与确认。
responsibility.en: Review the final cut against production goals and record findings, decision owners and revision scope. Deliver: final review and confirmation.

responsibility.zh: 检查画音同步、字幕、色彩、响度与格式，核对交付版本。交付：技术质检与导出文件。
responsibility.en: Check synchronization, captions, color, audio levels and formats against delivery versions. Deliver: technical QC and exported files.

name.en: Final review and quality checks review

responsibility.zh: 核对成片内容、技术规格与可交付性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review content, technical formats and deliverability and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 交付批准成片、格式和使用说明，记录实际接收与遗漏事项。交付：成片交付与接收记录。
responsibility.en: Deliver approved files, formats and usage guidance and record receipt and omissions. Deliver: final delivery and receipt record.

responsibility.zh: 归档工程、素材、版本和使用记录，复盘制作与后期协作问题。交付：素材归档与制作复盘。
responsibility.en: Archive projects, media, versions and usage evidence and review production collaboration. Deliver: media archive and production retrospective.

responsibility.zh: 核对客户接收与可追溯素材并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review client receipt and traceable media and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 确认缺失或不合格镜头、音频及影响范围，按确认计划补拍、恢复或替换素材。
responsibility.en: Identify missing or unsuitable shots and audio and perform approved reshoots, recovery or replacement.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

summary.zh: 从受众、渠道和预算到并行素材建设，经上线核验、效果归因和优化复盘。
summary.en: Move from audience, channels and budget through parallel assets, launch checks, attribution and optimization.

instructions.zh: 从受众、渠道和预算到并行素材建设，经上线核验、效果归因和优化复盘。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Move from audience, channels and budget through parallel assets, launch checks, attribution and optimization. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 整理受众需求、竞争信息与购买路径，说明定位和细分依据。交付：受众与市场分析。
responsibility.en: Review audience needs, competitors and customer journeys to support positioning and segmentation. Deliver: audience and market analysis.

responsibility.zh: 明确传播、获客或转化目标，约定指标口径、时间和解释范围。交付：营销目标与指标口径。
responsibility.en: Define awareness, acquisition or conversion goals and agree measures, timing and interpretation limits. Deliver: campaign goals and measurement definitions.

responsibility.zh: 核对市场证据、受众与成功指标并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review market evidence, audiences and success measures and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 选择渠道、信息和内容组合，说明各渠道的作用与关联。交付：渠道与内容策略。
responsibility.en: Choose channels, messages and content and explain their roles and relationships. Deliver: channel and content strategy.

responsibility.zh: 分配预算、排期和测试范围，明确控制条件与调整责任人。交付：预算与实验计划。
responsibility.en: Allocate budget, schedule and experiments and define controls and adjustment ownership. Deliver: budget and experiment plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对渠道组合、预算与实验依据并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review channel mix, budget and experiment rationale and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 制作信息、视觉和渠道变体，登记版本与素材使用依据。交付：可审阅营销素材。
responsibility.en: Produce messages, visuals and channel variants with versions and usage evidence. Deliver: reviewable campaign assets.

responsibility.zh: 准备页面、表单、链接和跟踪口径，核对内容与营销目标一致。交付：承接路径与跟踪检查。
responsibility.en: Prepare pages, forms, links and measurement settings aligned with campaign goals. Deliver: conversion paths and tracking checks.

name.en: Parallel assets and conversion paths review

responsibility.zh: 核对素材、页面与跟踪一致性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review assets, destination pages and tracking consistency and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对品牌、事实、承诺、素材来源和适用发布安排，登记确认意见。交付：上线审阅记录。
responsibility.en: Review brand, facts, claims, sources and publication arrangements and record decisions. Deliver: launch review record.

responsibility.zh: 实测渠道设置、预算限制、链接、表单和数据回流，确认责任人。交付：投放与链路验证。
responsibility.en: Test channel settings, budget limits, links, forms and data return with assigned ownership. Deliver: campaign and conversion-path checks.

responsibility.zh: 核对素材准入、预算和渠道就绪并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review asset approval, budget and channel readiness and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 成员执行确认方案，跟踪花费、覆盖、问题和调整记录。交付：活动执行与观察记录。
responsibility.en: Members execute the approved plan and track spending, reach, issues and adjustments. Deliver: campaign execution and observation.

responsibility.zh: 对照指标口径核对数据、转化质量和外部影响，区分相关与因果解释。交付：效果与归因报告。
responsibility.en: Check data, conversion quality and external effects against definitions and distinguish correlation from causal claims. Deliver: performance and attribution report.

responsibility.zh: 核对实际执行、数据质量与效果并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review execution, measurement quality and outcomes and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 根据证据提出素材、渠道或预算调整，明确实验条件与预期效果。交付：优化建议与实验结果。
responsibility.en: Use evidence to propose asset, channel or budget changes with clear experiment conditions. Deliver: optimization proposals and experiment results.

responsibility.zh: 归档有效素材、版本、成本和经验，整理下一轮活动的待确认事项。交付：营销复盘与资产清单。
responsibility.en: Archive effective assets, versions, costs and lessons and propose next-cycle work. Deliver: campaign retrospective and asset list.

responsibility.zh: 核对优化依据与可复用成果并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review optimization evidence and reusable results and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对预算异常、错误素材或渠道故障，暂停受影响活动，记录修正方案与恢复条件。
responsibility.en: Investigate budget, asset or channel failures, pause affected activity and document corrections and recovery criteria.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: 澳大利亚政府营销计划指南

name.zh: 商品运营与订单售后闭环

summary.zh: 连接商品、库存、页面活动、订单核验、履约、售后和运营复盘。
summary.en: Connect products, inventory, store campaigns, order checks, fulfilment, returns and operations review.

instructions.zh: 连接商品、库存、页面活动、订单核验、履约、售后和运营复盘。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Connect products, inventory, store campaigns, order checks, fulfilment, returns and operations review. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 明确客群、商品定位与阶段目标，定义评价口径和运营边界。交付：经营目标与客群说明。
responsibility.en: Define customers, product positioning, milestones and measurement boundaries. Deliver: business goals and customer definition.

responsibility.zh: 核对商品需求、供给、成本和差异化，提出选品与上架范围。交付：选品与商品计划。
responsibility.en: Review demand, supply, costs and differentiation and propose the product range. Deliver: merchandising and product plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对经营目标与商品策略并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review business goals and product strategy and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对规格、图片、价格、服务承诺与素材使用，统一商品口径。交付：商品资料与价格清单。
responsibility.en: Verify specifications, images, prices, service commitments and usage to keep product definitions consistent. Deliver: product information and pricing list.

responsibility.zh: 核对库存、补货、供应时间和仓储容量，明确缺货及调整的责任人。交付：库存与供应计划。
responsibility.en: Check stock, replenishment, supply timing and warehouse capacity with exception ownership. Deliver: inventory and supply plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对商品资料、库存与供应条件并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review product information, stock and supply conditions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 制作商品与活动页面，核对优惠、库存提示和购买路径。交付：店铺与活动配置。
responsibility.en: Prepare product and campaign pages and verify offers, availability and purchasing journeys. Deliver: store and campaign setup.

responsibility.zh: 准备咨询、售后、仓储和运输信息，核对跨团队处理路径。交付：服务与履约准备清单。
responsibility.en: Prepare support, returns, warehouse and shipping information with cross-team handoffs. Deliver: service and fulfilment checklist.

responsibility.zh: 核对页面、活动与服务准备并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review pages, campaigns and service readiness and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 成员完成确认的上线，实测商品、优惠、支付和信息展示。交付：上线与交易链路验证。
responsibility.en: Members publish approved changes and test products, offers, payment and displayed information. Deliver: publication and transaction-path checks.

responsibility.zh: 核对订单、支付和风险标记，对异常情况按项目规则人工审阅。交付：订单核验与处理意见。
responsibility.en: Check orders, payment and risk flags and route exceptions for human review. Deliver: order checks and disposition.

responsibility.zh: 核对上线结果、支付与订单风险并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review publication, payment and order risks and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 仓储按确认订单配货，核对商品、数量、包装及发运信息。交付：出库与发运记录。
responsibility.en: Warehouse staff pick approved orders and verify products, quantities, packaging and dispatch details. Deliver: warehouse and dispatch record.

responsibility.zh: 跟踪运输和签收，记录延误、损坏或差错并与客服交接。交付：配送与签收记录。
responsibility.en: Track shipping and receipt and hand delays, damage or errors to support. Deliver: delivery and receipt record.

responsibility.zh: 核对配货、发货和配送证据并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review picking, shipping and delivery evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对客户诉求、商品状态与处理依据，执行经确认的退换或退款安排。交付：售后处理与客户记录。
responsibility.en: Review customer requests, item condition and evidence before applying approved return or refund decisions. Deliver: returns disposition and customer record.

responsibility.zh: 核对订单、库存、退款、运输和平台费用，登记差异与责任人。交付：运营对账与差异清单。
responsibility.en: Reconcile orders, stock, refunds, shipping and platform fees and assign discrepancies. Deliver: operations reconciliation and discrepancy list.

responsibility.zh: 核对售后依据与业务数据一致性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review returns evidence and business-data consistency and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 对照目标核对商品表现、流量、交易及客户反馈，说明限制。交付：经营与用户反馈报告。
responsibility.en: Review product performance, traffic, transactions and customer feedback against goals. Deliver: business and user feedback report.

responsibility.zh: 复盘库存、服务、履约和售后问题，提出需确认的下一轮改进。交付：运营改进与行动建议。
responsibility.en: Review inventory, service, fulfilment and returns and propose next-cycle improvements. Deliver: operations improvements and action proposals.

responsibility.zh: 核对收益、服务和供应反馈并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review business results, service and supply feedback and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对缺货、错发、延迟或高风险订单，协调客户和仓储，记录经确认的处理及恢复。
responsibility.en: Investigate stockouts, delivery errors, delays or high-risk orders and coordinate approved customer and warehouse responses.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: 澳大利亚政府营销计划指南

name.zh: 课题研究与可复现成果

summary.zh: 从问题、方案和评审到数据与研究并行准备，经分析复核、成果评审和资料开放。
summary.en: Move from questions and design through parallel preparation, analytical verification, results review and reproducible materials.

instructions.zh: 从问题、方案和评审到数据与研究并行准备，经分析复核、成果评审和资料开放。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Move from questions and design through parallel preparation, analytical verification, results review and reproducible materials. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 明确研究问题、假设、价值和可检验范围，区分探索与验证目标。交付：问题与假设说明。
responsibility.en: Define questions, hypotheses, value and testable boundaries and distinguish exploration from confirmation. Deliver: question and hypothesis statement.

responsibility.zh: 整理相关研究和材料，记录方法、证据不足及需要解决的差异。交付：文献与证据地图。
responsibility.en: Review relevant studies and materials and identify methods, evidence gaps and unresolved differences. Deliver: literature and evidence map.

responsibility.zh: 核对研究问题与既有证据并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review research questions and existing evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 确定样本、变量、测量、对照与分析方法，记录推断范围和偏差控制。交付：研究与分析方案。
responsibility.en: Define samples, variables, measures, comparisons and analysis with inference limits and bias controls. Deliver: study and analysis plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对资源、人员、数据使用和适用审阅安排，确认准备条件。交付：研究准入与资源记录。
responsibility.en: Check resources, people, data use and applicable review arrangements for readiness. Deliver: study readiness and resource record.

responsibility.zh: 核对方法、分析方案和适用审阅并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review methods, analysis plans and applicable review and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 按确认方法开展研究，登记偏差、环境、参数和实际执行过程。交付：研究过程与实验记录。
responsibility.en: Conduct the study using approved methods and record deviations, environments, parameters and execution. Deliver: study process and experimental records.

responsibility.zh: 保留原始数据与变换记录，检查完整性、标识和异常处理。交付：数据版本与质量报告。
responsibility.en: Preserve source data and transformations and verify completeness, identifiers and anomaly treatment. Deliver: data versions and quality report.

responsibility.zh: 核对研究记录与可核对数据并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review study records and verifiable data and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 执行确认的分析，说明不确定性、假设和结论的适用范围。交付：分析结果与解释。
responsibility.en: Execute the agreed analysis and explain uncertainty, assumptions and applicability. Deliver: analysis results and interpretation.

responsibility.zh: 由不同人员复核关键结果和分析材料，登记无法复现的差异。交付：复现与核验记录。
responsibility.en: Different staff verify key results and analysis materials and record reproducibility differences. Deliver: reproduction and verification record.

responsibility.zh: 核对分析正确性与可复现性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review analytical correctness and reproducibility and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 整理研究问题、方法、数据与限制，将事实和推断清晰区分。交付：研究成果稿。
responsibility.en: Report questions, methods, data and limits and clearly separate observations from inferences. Deliver: research result draft.

responsibility.zh: 审阅方法、结论、材料和限制，记录质疑、回应及修改依据。交付：审阅与回应记录。
responsibility.en: Review methods, conclusions, materials and limits and record questions, responses and revisions. Deliver: review and response record.

responsibility.zh: 核对结论、论证与材料一致性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review conclusions, arguments and material consistency and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 交付确认成果，按适用范围归档数据、代码、方法和版本。交付：成果与可复现资料包。
responsibility.en: Deliver approved results and archive permitted data, code, methods and versions. Deliver: results and reproducible-material package.

responsibility.zh: 记录未解决问题、复现反馈和后续研究建议，保持成果变更可追溯。交付：研究复盘与后续问题。
responsibility.en: Record open questions, reproduction feedback and future research proposals with traceable changes. Deliver: study retrospective and future questions.

responsibility.zh: 核对成果接收与可复用资料并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review accepted results and reusable materials and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 登记异常数据、分析偏差和受影响结论，核对方法与资料后提出修订或补充研究。
responsibility.en: Record data anomalies, analytical bias and affected conclusions and propose corrections or additional work.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: NIH 研究严谨性与可重复性

name.zh: 课程开发与学习效果验证

summary.zh: 连接需求分析、教学设计、并行课件与评估建设、试讲、正式教学和效果改进。
summary.en: Connect needs analysis, instructional design, parallel materials and assessment, pilots, teaching and outcome improvement.

instructions.zh: 连接需求分析、教学设计、并行课件与评估建设、试讲、正式教学和效果改进。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Connect needs analysis, instructional design, parallel materials and assessment, pilots, teaching and outcome improvement. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.
