responsibility.zh: 确认需要改善的实际表现、能力缺口和培训是否适合解决该问题。交付：培训需求与能力缺口。
responsibility.en: Identify performance gaps, missing competencies and whether training suits the problem. Deliver: training needs and competency gaps.

responsibility.zh: 核对学习者基础、时间、语言、设备和支持需求。交付：学习者与条件分析。
responsibility.en: Review learners, prior knowledge, timing, language, equipment and support requirements. Deliver: learner and condition analysis.

responsibility.zh: 核对能力缺口与学习条件并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review competency gaps and learning conditions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 建立可验证目标、课程次序和前置知识，说明目标之间的关系。交付：目标与课程结构。
responsibility.en: Define measurable objectives, course sequence and prerequisites and explain relationships. Deliver: objectives and course structure.

responsibility.zh: 设计练习、教学活动、评估与反馈方式，确保与目标对应。交付：教学与评价方案。
responsibility.en: Design practice, activities, assessment and feedback aligned with the objectives. Deliver: instruction and assessment strategy.

responsibility.zh: 核对目标、活动与评价一致性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review alignment of goals, activities and assessment and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 制作课件、案例、练习和学习指南，标注来源与版本。交付：课程与学习材料。
responsibility.en: Produce courseware, cases, practice and learning guides with sources and versions. Deliver: course and learning materials.

responsibility.zh: 制作评价任务、评分依据和教师指南，验证使用方式与支持条件。交付：评价工具与教师指南。
responsibility.en: Prepare assessments, scoring evidence and instructor guides and verify delivery support. Deliver: assessment tools and instructor guides.

responsibility.zh: 核对材料、评估与教学支持并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review materials, assessment and teaching support and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 在代表性范围试讲，观察时间、理解、练习和工具的使用。交付：试讲与观察记录。
responsibility.en: Pilot with representative learners and observe timing, comprehension, practice and tool use. Deliver: pilot and observation record.

responsibility.zh: 整理试讲反馈，修订难点、材料、节奏与评价任务。交付：质量审阅与修订记录。
responsibility.en: Review pilot feedback and revise difficulties, materials, pacing and assessments. Deliver: quality review and revision record.

responsibility.zh: 核对试讲结果与材料可用性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review pilot findings and material usability and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 教师按确认安排授课，记录学习进展、困难和必要的过程调整。交付：教学与学习支持记录。
responsibility.en: Instructors deliver the approved plan and record progress, difficulties and necessary adjustments. Deliver: teaching and learner-support record.

responsibility.zh: 实施目标相关评价，提供可行动反馈并记录未达到目标的情况。交付：学习评价与反馈。
responsibility.en: Assess against objectives, provide actionable feedback and record unmet goals. Deliver: learning assessment and feedback.

responsibility.zh: 核对实际教学与学习反馈并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review actual teaching and learner feedback and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对能力改善和实际应用证据，说明评价口径和观察限制。交付：学习效果与应用报告。
responsibility.en: Review competency and application evidence with measurement definitions and observation limits. Deliver: learning outcomes and application report.

responsibility.zh: 归档版本与经验，提出材料、活动和教师支持的后续改进。交付：课程维护与改进计划。
responsibility.en: Archive versions and lessons and propose improvements to materials, activities and instructor support. Deliver: course maintenance and improvement plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对学习效果与后续应用并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review learning outcomes and subsequent application and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 识别未达到目标的任务和群体，检查前置知识、教材和授课方式，提出补充训练与修订。
responsibility.en: Identify unmet learning goals and groups, review prerequisites, materials and delivery, and propose remedial practice and revisions.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

summary.zh: 连接活动目标、方案、供应资源、现场演练、执行、应急恢复和结项。
summary.en: Connect goals, planning, suppliers, site rehearsals, execution, incident recovery and closure.

instructions.zh: 连接活动目标、方案、供应资源、现场演练、执行、应急恢复和结项。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Connect goals, planning, suppliers, site rehearsals, execution, incident recovery and closure. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 明确活动目的、参与者、规模和成果，约定衡量效果的方式。交付：活动目标与受众说明。
responsibility.en: Define purpose, participants, scale and outcomes with measures of success. Deliver: event goals and audience brief.

responsibility.zh: 核对预算、排期、场地条件和关键风险，明确组织责任。交付：预算与风险清单。
responsibility.en: Review budget, schedule, venue conditions and risks with organizational ownership. Deliver: budget and risk register.

responsibility.zh: 核对活动价值、受众与资源边界并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review event value, audience and resource boundaries and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 设计活动内容、顺序、嘉宾与参与方式，标明关键切换和等待。交付：活动方案与流程表。
responsibility.en: Design content, sequence, guests and participation with key transitions and waits. Deliver: event program and running order.

responsibility.zh: 落实场地、供应商、人员与交接职责，确认服务规格。交付：团队与供应资源安排。
responsibility.en: Coordinate venue, suppliers, people and handoffs with service requirements. Deliver: team and supplier arrangements.

responsibility.zh: 核对节目流程与人员分工并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review program sequence and responsibilities and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对布置、设备、物料、标识和技术系统，记录就绪与缺项。交付：现场资源检查。
responsibility.en: Check setup, equipment, materials, signage and technical systems and record readiness gaps. Deliver: site resource checks.

responsibility.zh: 确认嘉宾、报名、接待、交通和参与说明，登记特殊需求。交付：参与者与服务清单。
responsibility.en: Confirm guests, registration, reception, travel and participant information with special requirements. Deliver: participant and service checklist.

responsibility.zh: 核对现场资源与参与者服务并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review site resources and participant services and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

name.zh: 全流程演练与问题修正

responsibility.zh: 演练切换、音视频、接待和现场职责，修正操作与信息差异。交付：演练记录与修正清单。
responsibility.en: Rehearse transitions, media, reception and responsibilities and correct operational discrepancies. Deliver: rehearsal record and corrections.

responsibility.zh: 核对人员、场地、资源和已确认预案，明确异常时的联络与决策。交付：开场准入与预案记录。
responsibility.en: Check people, venue, resources and response plans with communication and decision ownership. Deliver: opening readiness and response record.

responsibility.zh: 核对流程实测与应急协作并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review rehearsal evidence and response coordination and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 统筹活动顺序、技术、嘉宾与供应，记录实际变更和事件。交付：现场运行与变更记录。
responsibility.en: Coordinate program, technology, guests and suppliers and record changes and events. Deliver: site operation and change record.

responsibility.zh: 提供接待、支持和信息服务，登记参与反馈与需要升级的事项。交付：服务与参与反馈。
responsibility.en: Provide reception, support and information and record feedback and escalation needs. Deliver: service and participant feedback.

responsibility.zh: 核对实际流程、服务与问题处置并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review actual program, services and issue handling and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对设备、物料、场地交还与费用，记录未完成事项。交付：撤场与费用核对。
responsibility.en: Verify equipment, materials, venue return and costs and record remaining items. Deliver: demobilization and reconciliation.

responsibility.zh: 对照目标核对成果、参与反馈和事件，整理下一次改进建议。交付：活动成效与复盘。
responsibility.en: Review results, participant feedback and incidents against goals and propose improvements. Deliver: event results and retrospective.

responsibility.zh: 核对资源接收、结算与活动成效并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review resource receipt, reconciliation and event results and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 现场责任人按已确认预案协调人员、场地和信息，记录处置及恢复状态；需要停办或调整时由有权人决定。
responsibility.en: Assigned staff coordinate people, venue and information under the approved response plan and record recovery; authorized humans decide suspension or changes.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: HSE 活动策划与现场管理
PMI 项目交付与收益实现

summary.zh: 从委托边界与诊断证据，经多方向方案比较、试点、客户验收和知识转移。
summary.en: Move from engagement boundaries and diagnosis through options, pilots, client acceptance and knowledge transfer.

instructions.zh: 从委托边界与诊断证据，经多方向方案比较、试点、客户验收和知识转移。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Move from engagement boundaries and diagnosis through options, pilots, client acceptance and knowledge transfer. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 澄清客户问题、成果用途和验收方式，记录相关利益方与限制。交付：客户目标与成果说明。
responsibility.en: Clarify the problem, intended use and acceptance with stakeholders and constraints. Deliver: client goals and outcomes.

responsibility.zh: 约定范围、方法、资料、协作、交付和变更处理，明确双方责任。交付：可审阅工作约定。
responsibility.en: Agree scope, methods, information, collaboration, delivery and change handling with ownership. Deliver: reviewable engagement agreement.

responsibility.zh: 核对客户目标与双方职责并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review client goals and agreed responsibilities and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 收集资料、访谈及业务现状，保留来源、假设和相互矛盾的信息。交付：诊断材料与调查记录。
responsibility.en: Collect materials, interviews and operational observations with sources, assumptions and contradictions. Deliver: diagnostic materials and investigation notes.

responsibility.zh: 整理流程、数据和组织问题，验证根因假设与问题影响。交付：现状诊断与根因说明。
responsibility.en: Analyze process, data and organizational issues and validate root-cause hypotheses and impact. Deliver: current-state diagnosis and root causes.

responsibility.zh: 核对资料可信度与问题解释并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review evidence reliability and problem explanation and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 提出可比较方案，说明收益、限制、风险和对客户组织的影响。交付：候选方案与比较。
responsibility.en: Develop comparable options with expected outcomes, limits, risks and organizational impact. Deliver: options and comparison.

responsibility.zh: 评估资源、依赖、分工和试点方式，说明实施中的关键假设。交付：实施路径与资源计划。
responsibility.en: Assess resources, dependencies, responsibilities and pilots with implementation assumptions. Deliver: implementation and resource plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对方案比较与实施可行性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review option comparison and implementation feasibility and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 客户与实施人员执行确认的试点，记录操作、结果和偏差。交付：试点与观察记录。
responsibility.en: Client and delivery staff execute the approved pilot and record actions, results and deviations. Deliver: pilot and observation record.

responsibility.zh: 核对试点目标、客户反馈和适用范围，修订方案与后续实施计划。交付：试点验证与修订方案。
responsibility.en: Verify pilot goals, client feedback and applicability and revise implementation plans. Deliver: pilot verification and revised proposal.

responsibility.zh: 核对试点证据与可执行改进并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review pilot evidence and actionable adjustments and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 支持客户落实确认方案，核对实际成果、剩余风险与变更。交付：实施成果与问题清单。
responsibility.en: Support agreed implementation and verify results, remaining risks and changes. Deliver: implementation results and issues.

responsibility.zh: 与客户核对范围、成果和证据，列出需补充或另行安排的事项。交付：客户审阅与验收记录。
responsibility.en: Review scope, results and evidence with the client and identify supplements and follow-up work. Deliver: client review and acceptance record.

responsibility.zh: 核对客户成果与人员可接收性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review client results and receiving-team readiness and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 交付方法、资料、培训和维护责任，检查客户能否继续使用成果。交付：知识转移与接收记录。
responsibility.en: Transfer methods, materials, training and maintenance ownership and verify continued use. Deliver: knowledge transfer and receipt.

responsibility.zh: 核对交付、未完成项与双方意见，确定后续收益观察和改进安排。交付：结项与收益观察计划。
responsibility.en: Review deliverables, open items and both parties’ findings and agree further benefits observation. Deliver: closure and benefits observation plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对接收、使用能力与委托关闭并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review receipt, usable knowledge and engagement closure and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 记录新增问题、影响和客户意见，重新评估范围、交付物与资源，由委托双方明确后续安排。
responsibility.en: Record new issues and client feedback and reassess scope, deliverables and resources for agreed follow-up.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: ICMCI 咨询服务过程指南
PMI 项目交付与收益实现

name.zh: 系统设计、样机与量产转移
name.en: System design, prototypes and production transfer

summary.zh: 并行协调结构、电子与固件，经接口集成、需求验证、场景验证和制造转移。
summary.en: Coordinate mechanical, electronic and firmware work through integration, verification, validation and manufacturing transfer.

instructions.zh: 并行协调结构、电子与固件，经接口集成、需求验证、场景验证和制造转移。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Coordinate mechanical, electronic and firmware work through integration, verification, validation and manufacturing transfer. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 明确功能、使用环境、性能、约束和可验证要求，记录验收依据。交付：系统需求与验收基线。
responsibility.en: Define functions, environments, performance, constraints and verifiable requirements with acceptance evidence. Deliver: system requirements and acceptance baseline.

responsibility.zh: 分解子系统、接口和责任边界，核对外部系统及供应依赖。交付：系统分解与接口说明。
responsibility.en: Break down subsystems, interfaces and ownership and assess external dependencies. Deliver: system decomposition and interface notes.

responsibility.zh: 核对需求、使用场景与接口边界并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review requirements, use cases and interface boundaries and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 设计结构、材料、装配和使用体验，核对与电子及生产的接口。交付：结构与工业设计资料。
responsibility.en: Design mechanics, materials, assembly and experience and verify electronic and manufacturing interfaces. Deliver: mechanical and industrial design.

responsibility.zh: 设计电子与固件方案，核对接口、功耗、异常和调试策略。交付：电子与固件方案。
responsibility.en: Design electronics and firmware with interfaces, power, failure handling and debugging strategies. Deliver: electronics and firmware proposal.

responsibility.zh: 核对设计方案、接口与风险并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review design proposals, interfaces and risks and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 按设计制作样机，登记部件、版本、装配和已知偏差。交付：样机配置与制作记录。
responsibility.en: Produce prototypes and record components, versions, assembly and known deviations. Deliver: prototype configuration and production record.

responsibility.zh: 按集成计划核对子系统接口、顺序、测试准备和实际连接结果。交付：系统集成与接口证据。
responsibility.en: Check interfaces, order, testing readiness and integration results against the plan. Deliver: system integration and interface evidence.

responsibility.zh: 核对样机、集成配置与接口结果并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review prototypes, integration configuration and interface results and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

name.zh: 功能性能与可靠性验证

responsibility.zh: 对照需求验证功能、性能和相关失效风险，保留可核对的测试配置。交付：需求验证与失效记录。
responsibility.en: Verify requirements, performance and failure risks with identifiable test configurations. Deliver: requirements verification and failure record.

responsibility.zh: 在适用环境检查使用、维护和操作表现，记录需求以外的使用问题。交付：场景验证与使用反馈。
responsibility.en: Validate use, maintenance and operation in applicable environments and record unexpected usability issues. Deliver: use validation and feedback.

name.zh: 需求验证与使用确认评审

responsibility.zh: 核对要求满足情况与实际场景表现并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review requirements satisfaction and realistic use performance and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 准备工艺、治具、操作资料及部件供应，核对可制造性。交付：生产工艺与准备资料。
responsibility.en: Prepare processes, tooling, work materials and component supply and review manufacturability. Deliver: production process and readiness materials.

responsibility.zh: 进行经确认的试产，核对良率、测量、装配和生产偏差。交付：试产与质量验证结果。
responsibility.en: Run approved pilot production and check yield, measurement, assembly and process deviations. Deliver: pilot production and quality evidence.

responsibility.zh: 核对可制造性、工艺与质量计划并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review manufacturability, process and quality plans and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 交付确认的设计、配置、工艺和质量资料，核对制造与服务接收。交付：制造转移与接收记录。
responsibility.en: Transfer approved designs, configurations, processes and quality materials and confirm receipt. Deliver: manufacturing transfer and receipt.

responsibility.zh: 登记使用和生产失效，核对影响后提出设计、测试或工艺改进。交付：设计维护与改进记录。
responsibility.en: Track operational and production failures and propose design, testing or process improvements after impact review. Deliver: design maintenance and improvements.

responsibility.zh: 核对制造接收与版本维护并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review manufacturing receipt and version maintenance and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 隔离故障样机，核对失效、接口和变更证据，确认需要调整的设计与重新验证范围。
responsibility.en: Isolate failed prototypes, inspect failure and interface evidence, and define design corrections and repeat checks.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: ASQ 产品与过程质量策划

summary.zh: 连接需求、工艺、供应与设备准备、试产、正式生产、检验和不合格处置。
summary.en: Connect demand, process, supply and equipment readiness, pilots, production, inspection and nonconformance handling.

instructions.zh: 连接需求、工艺、供应与设备准备、试产、正式生产、检验和不合格处置。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Connect demand, process, supply and equipment readiness, pilots, production, inspection and nonconformance handling. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 核对数量、产品版本、交期和产能，记录优先级与约束。交付：生产需求与交付计划。
responsibility.en: Check volumes, product versions, deadlines and capacity with priorities and constraints. Deliver: production demand and delivery plan.

responsibility.zh: 明确质量特性、检验依据和过程风险，登记关键控制点。交付：质量目标与风险清单。
responsibility.en: Define quality characteristics, inspection evidence and process risks with control points. Deliver: quality goals and risk register.

name.zh: 生产需求与质量目标评审

responsibility.zh: 核对需求、产能与质量要求并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review demand, capacity and quality requirements and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 设计工序、作业与交接方式，核对材料、设备和关键参数。交付：工艺流程与作业指导。
responsibility.en: Design operations and handoffs and verify materials, equipment and critical parameters. Deliver: process flow and work instructions.

responsibility.zh: 确定测量、抽检、异常处理和记录要求，明确检验与放行责任。交付：测量与控制计划。
responsibility.en: Define measurement, sampling, exceptions and records with inspection and release ownership. Deliver: measurement and control plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对工艺、测量与控制方案并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review process, measurement and controls and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对材料与部件的版本、批次、数量和来料检验状态。交付：材料与来料检查。
responsibility.en: Check material and component versions, batches, quantities and incoming inspection. Deliver: materials and incoming checks.

responsibility.zh: 检查设备、工装、维护、校验和人员作业能力，登记缺项。交付：设备与人员就绪记录。
responsibility.en: Check equipment, tooling, maintenance, calibration and operator readiness and record gaps. Deliver: equipment and people readiness.

responsibility.zh: 核对材料、设备与人员就绪并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review materials, equipment and people readiness and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 按确认流程试产，记录工序结果、测量、良率和异常。交付：试产与过程验证记录。
responsibility.en: Run an approved pilot and record process results, measurements, yield and exceptions. Deliver: pilot and process validation.

responsibility.zh: 核对关键质量与过程能力，落实工艺、控制计划和操作修订。交付：生产准入与修订记录。
responsibility.en: Review critical quality and capability and update processes, controls and instructions. Deliver: production readiness and revision record.

responsibility.zh: 核对试产、能力与修订闭合并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review pilot results, capability and closed revisions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 成员按确认安排生产，记录批次、材料、参数、工序与偏差。交付：生产追溯与过程记录。
responsibility.en: Operators follow approved arrangements and record batches, materials, parameters, operations and deviations. Deliver: production traceability and records.

responsibility.zh: 核对关键工序、产品和质量证据，对不合格项登记并升级处理。交付：检验结果与质量问题。
responsibility.en: Inspect critical operations and final products and record nonconformance for disposition. Deliver: inspection results and quality issues.

responsibility.zh: 核对生产追溯与检验结果并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review production traceability and inspection results and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 由有权人确认放行依据，核对入库、交付与客户要求。交付：放行与交付记录。
responsibility.en: Authorized staff confirm release evidence and check storage, delivery and customer requirements. Deliver: release and delivery record.

responsibility.zh: 汇集客户、过程和不合格反馈，提出控制计划与工艺改进。交付：质量复盘与改进计划。
responsibility.en: Combine customer, process and nonconformance feedback and propose control and process improvements. Deliver: quality review and improvement plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对放行依据、客户接收与质量反馈并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review release evidence, client receipt and quality feedback and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 隔离受影响批次，记录缺陷、根因和处置意见，执行确认的返工并重新检验。
responsibility.en: Contain affected batches, document defects and causes, apply approved rework and repeat inspection.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: ASQ 产品与过程质量策划

summary.zh: 从需求规格、市场与供应商评估，到招采、交付、验收、对账和供应复盘。
summary.en: Move from requirements, market and supplier assessment through sourcing, delivery, acceptance, reconciliation and supplier review.

instructions.zh: 从需求规格、市场与供应商评估，到招采、交付、验收、对账和供应复盘。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Move from requirements, market and supplier assessment through sourcing, delivery, acceptance, reconciliation and supplier review. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 确认业务用途、数量、时间、预算和可替代范围。交付：采购需求与预算依据。
responsibility.en: Confirm purpose, volumes, timing, budget and acceptable alternatives. Deliver: procurement needs and budget evidence.

responsibility.zh: 定义功能、服务、质量与验收证据，避免无法比较的报价口径。交付：规格与验收标准。
responsibility.en: Define functional, service, quality and acceptance requirements using comparable definitions. Deliver: specifications and acceptance criteria.

responsibility.zh: 核对真实需求、预算与可评估规格并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review needs, budget and evaluable specifications and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 分析供应渠道、交付能力与集中风险，核对替代供应可能性。交付：市场与供应风险分析。
responsibility.en: Assess channels, delivery capability, concentration risks and possible alternative supply. Deliver: market and supply-risk analysis.

responsibility.zh: 核对供应商资料、能力与适用审阅，安排询价或招采资料。交付：供应商资格与邀约记录。
responsibility.en: Review supplier information, capability and applicable checks and prepare sourcing materials. Deliver: supplier qualification and invitation.

responsibility.zh: 核对供应市场与候选人可用性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review supply market and candidate availability and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 按事先确认的标准评估技术、服务、价格和交付条件。交付：供应方案与比较记录。
responsibility.en: Evaluate technical, service, pricing and delivery terms against agreed criteria. Deliver: supplier proposals and comparison.

responsibility.zh: 核对样品、质量、成本、履约安排及需协商的问题。交付：样品与商务核对。
responsibility.en: Verify samples, quality, costs, delivery arrangements and unresolved negotiations. Deliver: sample and commercial checks.

responsibility.zh: 核对预设标准、比较与取舍并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review predefined criteria, comparison and tradeoffs and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 有权人确认选择及条件，登记范围、交付、验收和变更安排。交付：采购确认与约定记录。
responsibility.en: Authorized humans confirm supplier selection and terms, delivery, acceptance and change arrangements. Deliver: procurement confirmation and terms.

responsibility.zh: 核对订单、版本、生产或备货进度，登记关键节点和责任人。交付：订单与供应进度。
responsibility.en: Check orders, versions, production or stock progress with milestones and ownership. Deliver: orders and supply progress.

responsibility.zh: 核对确认决定与可执行履约安排并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review confirmed decisions and actionable fulfilment arrangements and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对到货、数量、批次、运输状态和入库安排。交付：到货与仓储核对。
responsibility.en: Verify arrival, quantities, batches, transport condition and storage arrangements. Deliver: receiving and warehouse checks.

responsibility.zh: 业务与质量人员对照标准核验成果，记录差异及处理依据。交付：联合验收与差异记录。
responsibility.en: Business and quality staff verify results against criteria and record discrepancies and disposition evidence. Deliver: joint acceptance and discrepancies.

responsibility.zh: 核对实物、质量与业务可用性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review received goods, quality and business usability and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对订单、验收和账单，登记付款所需确认及差异处理。交付：对账与差异处置。
responsibility.en: Reconcile orders, acceptance and invoices and record required confirmations and discrepancies. Deliver: reconciliation and discrepancy handling.

responsibility.zh: 总结交付、质量、服务和风险变化，提出供应与规格优化。交付：供应商表现与改进。
responsibility.en: Review delivery, quality, service and risk changes and propose supplier and specification improvements. Deliver: supplier performance and improvements.

responsibility.zh: 核对单据一致性与供应表现并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review document consistency and supplier performance and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对延迟、数量或质量问题，协调供应商、仓储与业务，提出经确认的替代或补供安排。
responsibility.en: Investigate delays, quantity or quality issues and coordinate approved alternatives or replenishment.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: ASQ 产品与过程质量策划

summary.zh: 覆盖需求与现场、方案和预算、技术与采购准备、施工协调、验收移交及使用反馈。
summary.en: Cover brief and site, design and cost, technical and procurement readiness, site coordination, handover and use feedback.

instructions.zh: 覆盖需求与现场、方案和预算、技术与采购准备、施工协调、验收移交及使用反馈。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Cover brief and site, design and cost, technical and procurement readiness, site coordination, handover and use feedback. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

name.zh: 业主目标与项目任务书

responsibility.zh: 明确使用目的、范围、预算、交付及接收要求，登记相关利益方。交付：项目任务书与目标。
responsibility.en: Define use, scope, budget, delivery and receipt requirements with stakeholders. Deliver: project brief and goals.

responsibility.zh: 核对现场、既有设施、接口和资料，登记需要专业核验的事项。交付：现场与条件记录。
responsibility.en: Survey the site, existing facilities, interfaces and information and flag specialist checks. Deliver: site and condition record.

responsibility.zh: 核对目标、场地与项目边界并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review goals, site and project boundaries and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 提出空间、功能和主要设计方案，说明与使用目标和场地的关系。交付：概念与方案设计。
responsibility.en: Develop spatial, functional and design proposals against goals and site conditions. Deliver: concept and design proposal.

responsibility.zh: 核对估算、采购、排期和实施约束，说明设计与成本取舍。交付：成本与实施计划。
responsibility.en: Review estimates, procurement, schedule and delivery constraints with design-cost tradeoffs. Deliver: cost and implementation plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对方案适用性与预算取舍并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review design suitability and budget tradeoffs and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 整合结构、机电、材料和细节，核对专业接口与图纸版本。交付：协调设计与技术资料。
responsibility.en: Coordinate structures, services, materials and details and verify interfaces and drawing versions. Deliver: coordinated designs and technical materials.

responsibility.zh: 核对项目适用的审阅、许可、材料与变更确认安排，登记责任人。交付：准入与材料确认记录。
responsibility.en: Identify applicable reviews, permissions, material decisions and change arrangements with ownership. Deliver: readiness and material confirmation.

responsibility.zh: 核对技术一致性与适用确认并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review technical coordination and applicable confirmations and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 落实材料、设备、施工团队及关键供应节点，核对交付与检查方式。交付：供应与施工资源计划。
responsibility.en: Arrange materials, equipment, teams and supply milestones with delivery and checks. Deliver: supply and construction resource plan.

responsibility.zh: 确认施工顺序、场地接口、作业与现场管理安排。交付：施工准备与组织计划。
responsibility.en: Confirm construction order, site interfaces, work organization and site management. Deliver: construction readiness and organization plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对供应、场地与施工计划并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review supplies, site and construction plan and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 按确认设计与安排施工，登记进展、现场偏差和需审阅变更。交付：施工进展与变更记录。
responsibility.en: Execute agreed designs and record progress, deviations and proposed changes. Deliver: construction progress and change records.

responsibility.zh: 核对关键工序、接口、材料和检查记录，跟踪整改与复检。交付：质量证据与整改清单。
responsibility.en: Check operations, interfaces, materials and evidence and track correction and reinspection. Deliver: quality evidence and correction list.

responsibility.zh: 核对实际施工、专业接口与质量证据并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review actual works, interfaces and quality evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对工程成果、未完成项、使用维护资料和接收责任。交付：验收与移交包。
responsibility.en: Review completed works, remaining items, maintenance information and receiving ownership. Deliver: acceptance and handover package.

responsibility.zh: 登记使用反馈、缺陷和维护问题，提出经确认的后续处置。交付：使用与缺陷维护记录。
responsibility.en: Record use feedback, defects and maintenance issues and propose approved follow-up treatment. Deliver: use and defect maintenance record.

responsibility.zh: 核对移交完整性与使用反馈并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review handover completeness and use feedback and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 确认设计变更、质量或现场问题及影响，按项目程序暂停受影响工作、提出处置与复核安排。
responsibility.en: Review design, quality or site issues, hold affected work and propose authorized correction and reinspection.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: RIBA 建筑项目工作计划

name.zh: 结构化招聘与入职交接

summary.zh: 从用人需求与评估标准，经渠道与筛选、多方评价、录用确认和入职接收。
summary.en: Move from hiring needs and criteria through sourcing, screening, multi-party assessment, offers and onboarding receipt.

instructions.zh: 从用人需求与评估标准，经渠道与筛选、多方评价、录用确认和入职接收。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Move from hiring needs and criteria through sourcing, screening, multi-party assessment, offers and onboarding receipt. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 明确岗位目标、能力、职责与团队需求，确认招聘是否适合解决问题。交付：岗位与用人需求。
responsibility.en: Define role goals, competencies, responsibilities and team needs and confirm the hiring rationale. Deliver: role and hiring requirements.

responsibility.zh: 约定岗位条件、评价标准和参与职责，核对适用的招聘程序。交付：评价标准与招聘条件。
responsibility.en: Agree terms, assessment criteria and ownership with applicable hiring procedures. Deliver: assessment criteria and hiring terms.

responsibility.zh: 核对岗位目的、能力和招聘边界并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review role purpose, competencies and hiring boundaries and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 准备准确岗位信息、渠道、时间和候选人沟通，记录来源。交付：发布与渠道计划。
responsibility.en: Prepare accurate role information, channels, timing and candidate communication with sources. Deliver: publication and sourcing plan.

responsibility.zh: 设计与岗位相关的题目、实践任务和评分依据，统一评估方法。交付：结构化评估材料。
responsibility.en: Design job-related questions, work samples and scoring evidence for consistent assessment. Deliver: structured assessment materials.

responsibility.zh: 核对信息一致性与可用评估工具并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review consistent information and usable assessment tools and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 按确认标准核对候选材料，登记岗位匹配证据与缺口。交付：候选筛选记录。
responsibility.en: Review applications against agreed criteria and record role-fit evidence and gaps. Deliver: candidate screening record.

responsibility.zh: 确认候选意向、安排、评估说明和资料处理方式。交付：候选沟通与评估安排。
responsibility.en: Confirm interest, schedules, assessment information and appropriate handling of materials. Deliver: candidate communication and assessment plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对岗位相关证据与评估安排并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review job-related evidence and assessment arrangements and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 依据岗位任务核对技能和实践表现，按相同标准记录评价。交付：岗位能力评价记录。
responsibility.en: Assess job skills and work samples using consistent criteria and recorded evidence. Deliver: job competency assessment.

responsibility.zh: 由用人团队核对协作与相关能力，区分事实证据与主观判断。交付：团队与综合评价。
responsibility.en: The hiring team evaluates collaboration and relevant skills and separates evidence from subjective impressions. Deliver: team and broader assessment.

responsibility.zh: 核对岗位能力、团队协作与证据一致性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review competencies, collaboration and consistent evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 对照标准汇总评价，记录分歧、选择依据与有权人的决定。交付：录用决定与依据。
responsibility.en: Compare evidence with criteria and record disagreements, selection reasons and authorized decisions. Deliver: offer decision and evidence.

responsibility.zh: 核对岗位条件、双方确认和入职准备，登记需进一步处理的问题。交付：录用与条件确认记录。
responsibility.en: Confirm role terms, agreement and onboarding readiness and record remaining issues. Deliver: offer and terms confirmation.

responsibility.zh: 核对评价决策与双方条件并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review selection decisions and agreed terms and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 准备介绍、资料、访问和培训，明确入职支持与岗位交接责任。交付：入职支持与交接包。
responsibility.en: Prepare introductions, materials, access and training with onboarding and role handoff ownership. Deliver: onboarding support and handoff package.

responsibility.zh: 确认岗位职责接收，整理甄选、沟通和入职问题的改进建议。交付：岗位接收与招聘复盘。
responsibility.en: Confirm responsibility receipt and review assessment, communication and onboarding improvements. Deliver: role receipt and hiring retrospective.

responsibility.zh: 核对入职支持与职责接收并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review onboarding support and responsibility receipt and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

name.zh: 候选人退出与补充甄选

responsibility.zh: 记录退出、拒绝或评估争议，核对需求与候选池，提出递补或重新招募安排。
responsibility.en: Record withdrawal, rejection or disputed assessments and propose additional sourcing or selection against the role requirements.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

name.zh: 人才培养与岗位能力提升

summary.zh: 识别能力缺口，设计培养路径并协同训练、实践反馈和岗位效果验证。
summary.en: Identify competency gaps and combine development paths, training, practice feedback and role effectiveness checks.

instructions.zh: 识别能力缺口，设计培养路径并协同训练、实践反馈和岗位效果验证。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Identify competency gaps and combine development paths, training, practice feedback and role effectiveness checks. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 结合岗位职责、表现和本人反馈核对能力与工作条件。交付：岗位能力与条件盘点。
responsibility.en: Assess responsibilities, performance and personal feedback alongside work conditions. Deliver: role competency and condition assessment.

responsibility.zh: 约定需要改善的任务、能力和衡量方法，说明组织支持需求。交付：培养目标与支持说明。
responsibility.en: Agree target tasks, competencies and measures and define organizational support needs. Deliver: development goals and support brief.

responsibility.zh: 核对岗位表现与能力缺口并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review role performance and competency gaps and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 设计课程、导师、任务实践与阶段检查，使培养对应真实工作。交付：培养路径与实践计划。
responsibility.en: Design courses, mentoring, work practice and checks aligned with real tasks. Deliver: development path and practice plan.

responsibility.zh: 约定阶段证据、评价标准、反馈方式和本人参与安排。交付：培养评价与反馈方案。
responsibility.en: Agree stage evidence, criteria, feedback and participant involvement. Deliver: development evaluation and feedback plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对训练、实践与评价对应并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review alignment of training, practice and evaluation and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 准备课程、案例、练习和学习支持，核对目标与材料版本。交付：学习与训练材料。
responsibility.en: Prepare learning content, cases, practice and support against the objectives. Deliver: learning and training materials.

responsibility.zh: 确认导师职责、任务机会、时间和工作支持，记录实际约定。交付：导师与实践安排。
responsibility.en: Confirm mentors, practice opportunities, timing and work support and record the agreement. Deliver: mentor and practice arrangements.

responsibility.zh: 核对材料、导师与实践条件并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review materials, mentors and practice conditions and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 开展确认的训练和辅导，记录理解、困难与阶段成果。交付：训练过程与反馈。
responsibility.en: Deliver agreed training and coaching and record understanding, difficulties and results. Deliver: training progress and feedback.

responsibility.zh: 在支持条件下完成试行任务，观察工作表现与需要改进的环节。交付：试行实践与观察。
responsibility.en: Complete trial tasks with support and observe performance and areas to improve. Deliver: trial practice and observation.

responsibility.zh: 核对训练过程与实践反馈并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review training progress and practice feedback and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 在实际工作中应用所学，记录任务结果、导师意见和阻碍。交付：岗位实践与导师记录。
responsibility.en: Apply learning to real work and record results, mentor feedback and barriers. Deliver: role practice and mentor record.

responsibility.zh: 依据原目标核对能力改善，区分训练因素和工作条件变化。交付：能力与效果核验。
responsibility.en: Check improvement against goals and distinguish learning effects from changing work conditions. Deliver: competency and outcome verification.

responsibility.zh: 核对真实任务表现与能力改善并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review real-task performance and competency improvement and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 确认培养成果与岗位使用安排，记录本人和负责人意见。交付：培养成果与发展约定。
responsibility.en: Confirm development results and role application with participant and manager findings. Deliver: development results and agreement.

responsibility.zh: 整理有效方法、困难和支持需求，更新后续培养建议。交付：培养复盘与后续计划。
responsibility.en: Review effective methods, barriers and support and update future development proposals. Deliver: development retrospective and future plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对职责变化与后续支持并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review responsibility changes and ongoing support and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

name.zh: 实践障碍与培养路径调整

responsibility.zh: 核对未改善的表现、工作条件与训练假设，调整实践机会、支持和培养路径。
responsibility.en: Review unimproved performance, work conditions and learning assumptions and adjust practice, support and development paths.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

summary.zh: 依据问题与基线，经过根因验证、并行方案、试点、推广和持续控制。
summary.en: Use problem baselines, validated causes, parallel solutions, pilots, adoption and ongoing control.

instructions.zh: 依据问题与基线，经过根因验证、并行方案、试点、推广和持续控制。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Use problem baselines, validated causes, parallel solutions, pilots, adoption and ongoing control. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 明确需要改善的问题、影响、相关人员和工作边界。交付：问题与利益方说明。
responsibility.en: Define the problem, impact, stakeholders and work boundaries. Deliver: problem and stakeholder brief.

responsibility.zh: 定义可比较指标、基线和成功范围，记录目标的依据。交付：目标与评价基线。
responsibility.en: Define comparable metrics, baselines and success boundaries with supporting rationale. Deliver: goals and measurement baseline.

responsibility.zh: 核对客户需求、问题范围与改进目标并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review customer needs, problem boundaries and goals and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 记录实际流程、等待、返工和交接，核对与书面规则的差异。交付：现状流程与交接图。
responsibility.en: Map actual work, waits, rework and handoffs and compare them with documented rules. Deliver: current process and handoff map.

responsibility.zh: 收集基线数据，核对口径、样本、缺失和测量误差。交付：测量与基线证据。
responsibility.en: Collect baseline data and check definitions, samples, missing values and measurement errors. Deliver: measurement and baseline evidence.

responsibility.zh: 核对测量可信度与现状证据并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review measurement reliability and current-state evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 用现状证据检验原因，区分症状、关联和可控制因素。交付：根因分析与验证。
responsibility.en: Test causes against evidence and distinguish symptoms, correlations and controllable factors. Deliver: causal analysis and validation.

responsibility.zh: 提出流程、职责、信息或工具调整，说明依赖、风险和预期结果。交付：改进方案与风险评估。
responsibility.en: Propose process, responsibility, information or tool changes with dependencies and expected effects. Deliver: improvement proposals and risks.

responsibility.zh: 核对根因证据与方案可行性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review causal evidence and solution feasibility and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 成员在确认范围内试行改进，记录实际操作、成本和问题。交付：试点与观察记录。
responsibility.en: Members trial approved improvements and record actions, costs and issues. Deliver: pilot and observation record.

responsibility.zh: 按同一口径比较改进前后结果，核对附加影响与不确定性。交付：效果验证与比较。
responsibility.en: Compare results using consistent definitions and review side effects and uncertainty. Deliver: outcome verification and comparison.

responsibility.zh: 核对试点效果与附加影响并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review pilot outcomes and side effects and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 制作流程、职责和工作材料，安排相关人员理解与试用。交付：流程规范与培训材料。
responsibility.en: Prepare process guidance, responsibilities and materials and arrange learning and trial use. Deliver: process guidance and training materials.

responsibility.zh: 核对工具、数据、监控和支持，记录实际接收与未完成项。交付：运行接收与支持计划。
responsibility.en: Verify tools, data, monitoring and support and record receipt and open items. Deliver: operational receipt and support plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对可用流程、人员与支持并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review usable processes, people and support and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 定义持续指标、观察和异常处理责任，登记偏离目标的情况。交付：控制与异常管理记录。
responsibility.en: Define ongoing measures, observation and exception ownership and record deviations. Deliver: control and exception management.

responsibility.zh: 核对持续收益、人员反馈和新增问题，提出下一轮改进范围。交付：持续改进与收益报告。
responsibility.en: Review sustained benefits, user feedback and new problems and propose the next improvement scope. Deliver: improvement and benefits report.

responsibility.zh: 核对指标、异常和责任维护并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review metrics, exceptions and maintained ownership and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对试点偏差与附加影响，调整措施、测量或根因假设，取得确认后重试。
responsibility.en: Check deviations and side effects, revise measures, measurement or causal assumptions, and repeat after approval.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: PMI 项目交付与收益实现

name.zh: 跨团队项目治理与成果交付

summary.zh: 连接项目目标、计划基线、并行执行、阶段整合、验收交接和收益观察。
summary.en: Connect project goals, baselines, parallel delivery, stage integration, acceptance, handoff and benefits observation.

instructions.zh: 连接项目目标、计划基线、并行执行、阶段整合、验收交接和收益观察。 按阶段核对具体交付物，实线表示建议推进与并行协作，带条件说明的菱形表示人工评审，虚线表示返工或恢复后的重新审阅。仅在需要时进入异常路径，不重复执行已确认的成果。实际工作由成员在本地完成；正式安排、审批和验收仍由项目有权人确认。请先配置项目职位与工作前置条件。
instructions.en: Connect project goals, baselines, parallel delivery, stage integration, acceptance, handoff and benefits observation. Review deliverables by stage. Solid edges show advisory progression and parallel work; diamonds describe human reviews and dashed edges describe revision or recovery. Use exception paths only when needed; preserve accepted results. Members work locally. Authorized project humans confirm arrangements, approvals and acceptance. Configure positions and task prerequisites explicitly.

responsibility.zh: 明确项目目标、成果、范围、约束和需要参与确认的人员。交付：项目目标与范围说明。
responsibility.en: Define goals, results, scope, constraints and people responsible for confirmation. Deliver: project goals and scope brief.

responsibility.zh: 约定沟通、资料、审阅、变更与验收责任，不将流程图视为权限授予。交付：项目协作与职责约定。
responsibility.en: Agree communication, materials, reviews, changes and acceptance without treating diagrams as authority. Deliver: project collaboration and responsibility agreement.

responsibility.zh: 核对项目价值、范围与确认职责并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review project value, scope and decision responsibilities and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 拆分可交付成果和工作，明确真实前置关系、交接与并行范围。交付：成果与依赖计划。
responsibility.en: Break down deliverables and work with actual prerequisites, handoffs and parallel scope. Deliver: deliverables and dependency plan.

responsibility.zh: 核对人员、资源、关键风险和阶段验收证据，建立计划基线。交付：资源风险与验收基线。
responsibility.en: Review people, resources, risks and stage acceptance evidence to establish a baseline. Deliver: resources, risks and acceptance baseline.

responsibility.zh: 核对任务、依赖、资源与验收依据并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review tasks, dependencies, resources and acceptance evidence and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 成员在本地执行已确认工作，提交阶段成果、状态和需要协调的事项。交付：主工作流阶段成果。
responsibility.en: Members deliver approved work locally and report results, status and coordination needs. Deliver: primary workstream results.

name.zh: 支撑资料与协作工作流

responsibility.zh: 同步准备资料、资源和跨团队支持，记录问题与交接。交付：支撑成果与协作记录。
responsibility.en: Prepare supporting information, resources and cross-team assistance with issue and handoff records. Deliver: supporting results and coordination record.

responsibility.zh: 核对工作成果、支持与问题记录并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review work results, support and issue records and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对跨工作流接口、成果版本、未满足依赖和交接记录。交付：整合与依赖核对。
responsibility.en: Verify workstream interfaces, versions, unmet dependencies and handoffs. Deliver: integration and dependency checks.

responsibility.zh: 对照阶段标准核对成果、证据与问题，提出需要确认的调整。交付：阶段审阅与问题清单。
responsibility.en: Review results, evidence and issues against stage criteria and propose adjustments. Deliver: stage review and issue list.

responsibility.zh: 核对整合结果与交接完整性并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review integrated results and complete handoffs and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 由有权人核对最终成果与标准，明确未完成事项和验收决定。交付：最终验收与决定。
responsibility.en: Authorized humans review final results and criteria and record open items and acceptance decisions. Deliver: final acceptance and decision.

responsibility.zh: 交付资料、使用和维护责任，记录接收方对成果的实际确认。交付：移交与接收记录。
responsibility.en: Hand over materials, use and maintenance ownership and record actual receiving confirmation. Deliver: handover and receipt record.

responsibility.zh: 核对最终成果、验收依据与接收并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review final results, acceptance evidence and receipt and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 归档成果、决定、版本和剩余安排，确认项目关闭条件。交付：结项资料与未完成事项。
responsibility.en: Archive results, decisions, versions and remaining arrangements and verify closure conditions. Deliver: closure materials and remaining items.

responsibility.zh: 检查目标收益和使用反馈，整理后续机会及协作改进建议。交付：收益与协作复盘。
responsibility.en: Review expected benefits and usage feedback and propose future opportunities and collaboration improvements. Deliver: benefits and collaboration retrospective.

responsibility.zh: 核对结项完整性与后续收益并记录有权人的评审结论。通过后推进；缺项时列明问题与责任人，按退回连线修订。
responsibility.en: Review complete closure and subsequent benefits and record the authorized human decision. Advance after acceptance; document issues and owners before returning work.

responsibility.zh: 核对偏差、依赖和范围变化，提出替代方案、资源或计划调整，交由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Assess deviations, dependencies and scope changes and propose alternatives or plan adjustments for authorized confirmation.

responsibility.zh: 核对异常影响、处置证据与恢复状态，明确哪些工作需要重新评审；获得有权人确认后再进入正常推进路径。
responsibility.en: Check impact, response evidence and recovery status. Identify reviews to repeat and obtain authorized confirmation before resuming.

title.zh: PMI 项目交付与收益实现
ICMCI 咨询服务过程指南

summary.zh: 前后端并行开发，统一测试与成果验收。
summary.en: Develop frontend and backend in parallel, then test and accept the result.

instructions.zh: 前后端并行开发，统一测试与成果验收。 按节点职责协作，连线表达建议顺序和并行关系。实际工作由成员在本地完成，平台记录材料、进展与建议。任务前置条件和审批授权由项目明确配置。
instructions.en: Develop frontend and backend in parallel, then test and accept the result. Collaborate according to node responsibilities; edges indicate advisory order and parallel work. Members carry out work locally and report materials, progress and suggestions. Configure task preconditions and approval authority explicitly in the project.

responsibility.zh: 完成需求确认，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete requirements and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

responsibility.zh: 完成方案设计，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete solution design and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

responsibility.zh: 完成前端开发，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete frontend development and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

responsibility.zh: 完成后端开发，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete backend development and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

responsibility.zh: 完成测试验收，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete testing and acceptance and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

responsibility.zh: 完成版本交付，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete version delivery and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

summary.zh: 从问题复现到修复验收，明确回归验证。
summary.en: Follow reproduction, repair and regression verification through acceptance.

instructions.zh: 从问题复现到修复验收，明确回归验证。 按节点职责协作，连线表达建议顺序和并行关系。实际工作由成员在本地完成，平台记录材料、进展与建议。任务前置条件和审批授权由项目明确配置。
instructions.en: Follow reproduction, repair and regression verification through acceptance. Collaborate according to node responsibilities; edges indicate advisory order and parallel work. Members carry out work locally and report materials, progress and suggestions. Configure task preconditions and approval authority explicitly in the project.

responsibility.zh: 完成问题确认，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete problem confirmation and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

responsibility.zh: 完成修复方案，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete repair plan and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

responsibility.zh: 完成代码修复，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete code repair and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

responsibility.zh: 完成回归验证，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete regression verification and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

responsibility.zh: 完成修复验收，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete repair acceptance and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

summary.zh: 核对变更、质量与发布准备，记录上线验证。
summary.en: Review changes, quality and release readiness, then record production verification.

instructions.zh: 核对变更、质量与发布准备，记录上线验证。 按节点职责协作，连线表达建议顺序和并行关系。实际工作由成员在本地完成，平台记录材料、进展与建议。任务前置条件和审批授权由项目明确配置。
instructions.en: Review changes, quality and release readiness, then record production verification. Collaborate according to node responsibilities; edges indicate advisory order and parallel work. Members carry out work locally and report materials, progress and suggestions. Configure task preconditions and approval authority explicitly in the project.

responsibility.zh: 完成变更汇总，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete change review and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

responsibility.zh: 完成质量确认，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
responsibility.en: Complete quality confirmation and record materials, results and handoff evidence. Authorized humans confirm formal decisions.

responsibility.zh: 完成发布准备，记录相关材料、结果与交接依据；需要正式确认的事项由有权人确认。
